item.title: 2026-11-21 心脏电生理日报（23 篇）
item.description:
共 23 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（12）

  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure Is Inferior to Best Medical Therapy for Patients With Atrial Fibrillation and High Bleeding and Stroke Risk.
    Am Fam Physician · 2026-11-20
  • Clopidogrel-Based Versus Aspirin-Based Double Antithrombotic Therapy After Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in Atrial Fibrillation Patients: Results of the ASAF-PCI Registry.
    Catheter Cardiovasc Interv · 2026-11-20
    在AF合并PCI的真实世界队列中，以阿司匹林或氯吡格雷为基础的双联抗栓治疗12个月净不良临床事件无显著差异。
  • Sex-Based Disparities in the In-Hospital Outcomes and Resource Utilization of Atrial Fibrillation in Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease.
    Clin Cardiol · 2026-11-20
    在AF合并COPD住院患者中，男性院内死亡率略高（5.8% vs 5.4%，aOR 1.039），住院时间更短、费用更高，出院转至专业护理机构的比例更低。
  • Case Report: Isoproterenol-dependent concealed right anteroseptal accessory pathway.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-20
    34岁男性反复心悸，基础电生理检查未诱发出心动过速，异丙肾上腺素激发后诱发出顺向型AVRT，证实为隐匿性右前间隔旁路并成功消融。
  • Device-detected new-onset atrial fibrillation after dual-chamber pacemaker implantation in patients with sick sinus syndrome under managed ventricular pacing: a risk nomogram from the 3-month landmark.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-20
    在病窦综合征双腔起搏器术后3个月无房性心律失常的患者中，年龄、P波最大时限、左房容积指数、心房起搏比例>50%和心室起搏比例>40%是设备检出性新发房颤的独立预测因素，5变量列线图模型在同中心时间验证中2-3年区分度良好。
  • Rising Atrial Fibrillation Mortality Trends in Hypertensive Patients Aged 25 and Older: A CDC Wonder Database Analysis.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-11-20
    1999至2023年美国25岁以上高血压患者中房颤相关死亡从3.8/10万升至35.9/10万，年均增长6.03%，男性、非西班牙裔白人和农村人群负担最重。
  • Antithrombotic Prescribing Pattern and Predictors of Oral Anticoagulants Use in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: Results from a hospital-based cross-sectional study of Nepal.
    Kathmandu Univ Med J (KUMJ) · 2026-11-20
    尼泊尔房颤患者中63.2%使用口服抗凝药，30.2%仍用抗血小板药；心衰、冠心病和中重度出血风险是OAC使用的预测因素。
  • Hemoglobin glycation index and mortality in critically ill atrial fibrillation patients: A retrospective cohort study from the MIMIC‑IV database.
    Medicine (Baltimore) · 2026-11-20
    在2458例ICU房颤患者中，血红蛋白糖化指数（HGI）与全因死亡呈反向J形关系，最低四分位组（Q1）30天和365天死亡风险最高。
  • MRI-Derived Atrial Substrate Score Predicts Recurrence After First-Time Cryoballoon Pulmonary Vein Isolation.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-20
    MRI衍生的心房基质评分（左房大小为主、纤维化为辅）可预测首次冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离后12个月房性心律失常复发，AUC 0.96，优于传统AF表型。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Function vs. Geometry: Predicting Thrombus Risk in Atrial Fibrillation.
    Turk Kardiyol Dern Ars · 2026-11-20
    在接受抗凝治疗的房颤患者中，左心耳面积变化分数（LAA FAC）是血栓/自发显影的独立预测因子，而二尖瓣环几何参数预测价值有限。
  • Distinct Sex-Associated Phenotypes of Sudden Cardiac Arrest Across Clinical, ECG, and Echocardiographic Domains: Replication in Two Communities and Comparison with the Framingham Heart Study.
    medRxiv · 2026-11-20
    在两个社区心脏骤停队列中，女性SCA患者更多合并非心脏共病、LVH和保留的LVEF，而男性更多合并冠心病、AF和QTc延长，这些性别差异与社区人群模式不同。
  • AF/AFL-related hospitalizations in a provincial Chinese discharge-record database, 2016-2024: a retrospective observational study.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-19
    中国省级出院记录数据库显示，2016-2024年AF/AFL相关住院记录增长252.7%，但再入院比例从26.4%升至70.9%，主要诊断与次要诊断患者的临床特征和结局显著不同。

室性心律失常（3）

  • Ultrasound-guided Stellate Ganglion Block for Refractory Electrical Storm and Acute Upper Limb Ischemia.
    Ann Afr Med · 2026-11-20
    超声引导星状神经节阻滞在7例急诊患者中改善难治性室速/电风暴发作频率及急性上肢缺血灌注，未见重大操作并发症。
  • Dynamic Risk Assessment of Severe Ventricular Arrhythmia in Patients With Implantable Defibrillators and Reduced Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-11-20
    基于心内电图动态变化的卷积神经网络模型可动态评估ICD合并HFrEF患者的多形性室速/室颤风险，外部验证AUC为0.725，优于静态临床变量模型。
  • Real-World Positivity, Procedural Events, and Management Changes After Intravenous Methylergometrine Provocation Testing for Coronary Vasospasm: A Single-Center Study of 139 Patients.
    Cureus · 2026-11-20
    单中心139例首次静脉甲基麦角新碱激发试验中，术者判定阳性率20.1%，阳性者均强化血管扩张治疗，阳性试验中约四分之一出现短暂事件且均自行缓解。

器械治疗（4）

  • Buckled Silver Microflake Conductors With In Situ-Generated Ag-O Coordination Enable 3D-Printed Stretchable Cardiac Bioelectrodes.
    Adv Mater · 2026-11-20
    一种基于银微片与Ag-O配位协同策略的3D打印可拉伸心脏电极，电导率约2.1×10⁴ S cm⁻¹，在50%循环应变下电阻稳定，具备无穿刺、生物安全性好的特点。
  • Conduction system versus biventricular pacing for cardiac resynchronization: A meta-analysis of randomized trials
    Open Science Framework · 2026-11-20
    在心力衰竭伴LVEF降低且符合CRT指征的成人中，传导系统起搏（希氏束或左束支区域起搏）对比双心室起搏，对LVEF改善非劣效，但试验间异质性可能受起搏方式、交叉和试验规模影响。
  • Left bundle branch area pacing in atrial fibrotic cardiomyopathy manifesting as atrial standstill: two case reports and mechanistic insights.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-19
    两例心房纤维化心肌病致心房静止患者，根据心房基质行单腔或双腔左束支区域起搏，实现心室同步或房室同步，QRS变窄且肺动脉压下降。
  • Iatrogenic axillary arteriovenous fistula complicating permanent pacemaker implantation: successful management with a balloon-expandable covered stent-a case report.
    J Med Case Rep · 2026-11-19
    57岁三度房室传导阻滞患者经左腋静脉植入永久起搏器时并发医源性腋动脉动静脉瘘，经覆膜支架封堵后改经对侧右腋静脉完成起搏器植入，随访1个月起搏器功能正常。

影像与标测（1）

  • Neural Architecture Search-Based ECG Classification for Low-Power Edge Deployment in IoT Healthcare Systems.
    IEEE J Transl Eng Health Med · 2026-11-20
    基于神经架构搜索的ECG分类模型在ARM Cortex-M33上实现实时推理，仅需21.7 kB RAM和265k MACs，每次推理能耗5.51 mJ，准确率97.4%，较原模型仅下降0.5%。

遗传与基础（2）

  • Differential effects of β1- and β2-adrenergic receptor block in long QT syndrome type 3: an in silico population study.
    Front Physiol · 2026-11-20
    在983个LQT3虚拟心室肌细胞中，β1阻滞通过减少IKs磷酸化增加心律失常易感性，而完全β2阻滞通过减少ICaL磷酸化降低易感性，部分β2阻滞无效。
  • RyR2-Mediated Ca 2+ Leak Drives Progressive Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy.
    bioRxiv · 2026-11-20
    RyR2-V2475F突变兔模型显示慢性RyR2介导的钙漏可导致恶性室性心律失常和进行性致心律失常性心肌病，选择性RyR2抑制可减少室速负荷并保护心脏功能。

其他（1）

  • Optimized Strategy for Improving the Accuracy of Determining Left Bundle Branch Capture.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-20
    在窄QRS波患者中，记录到左束支电位时采用ΔLBBpo-V6RWPT标准（截断值6 ms）判断左束支起搏捕获的准确性极高（AUC 1.000），未记录到电位时采用ΔV6RWPT标准（截断值30 ms）同样准确（AUC 0.990）。

item.title: 2026-11-20 心脏电生理日报（41 篇）
item.description:
共 41 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（13）

  • Incidence, Risk Factors and Natural History of Atrial Arrhythmias in Patients With Systemic Right Ventricle.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-11-19
    在447例系统性右心室成人中，超过半数发生房性心律失常，年龄>30岁、d-TGA和QRS增宽是独立危险因素，但AA并非死亡的独立预测因子。
  • Late pacemaker lead perforation in acute myopericarditis: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-11-19
    71岁双腔起搏器患者房颤消融后发生急性心肌心包炎，1个月后出现迟发起搏器导线穿孔，经装置修正及抗炎治疗后恢复。
  • Device embolization after percutaneous left atrial appendage occlusion: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Eur Heart J Valvular Struct Heart Dis · 2026-11-19
    LAAO术后器械栓塞发生率为0.31%，80%发生于术后24小时内，栓塞相关死亡率高达10.61%，且随时间无改善。
  • Successful catheter ablation of ventricular tachycardia after biologic ventricular assist tissue transplantation.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Serial high-density mapping reveals left atrial substrate progression despite durable pulmonary vein isolation.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Atrial fibrillation ablation in LMNA disease.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Pulsed field ablation of incisional right atrial flutter in a patient with a repaired atrial septal defect while avoiding right phrenic nerve injury: A case report.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Overcoming anatomical complexity: Atrial flutter ablation in the setting of left atrial isomerism and surgically repaired sinus venosus defect.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Atrial Fibrillation and Risk of Late-Onset Dementia
    JACC Advances · 2026-11-19
  • Preferential Conduction Along the Epicardial Ventricular Septum During Idiopathic Ventricular Arrhythmias Originating From the Basal LV Summit: A Pitfall for Anatomical Ablation.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-19
    特发性左室顶部室性心律失常中，约24%患者心大静脉内呈间隔激活模式，最早激动位于前室间静脉，与成功消融靶点距离较远，易误导解剖消融。
  • Discontinuation of Anticoagulation in Patients at Relatively High Risk of Stroke After Successful Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-19
    韩国全国队列显示，房颤消融成功且无复发、CHA2DS2-VA 2-4分者停用抗凝与复合事件及大出血风险降低相关，血栓栓塞未增加。
  • Peripartum Cardiomyopathy in Pakistan: A Systematic Review of Clinical Outcomes, Maternal and Obstetric Characteristics
    Research Square · 2026-11-19
    巴基斯坦围产期心肌病患者汇总死亡比例为15.6%，左室收缩功能恢复比例60.6%，主要心血管并发症为肺水肿（21.6%）。
  • Short-term and intermittent ECG-based screening for atrial fibrillation in older adults without known atrial fibrillation: a GRADE-assessed meta-analysis of randomized trials with time-to-event data.
    Aging Clin Exp Res · 2026-11-18
    在无已知房颤的老年人中，短期或间歇性心电筛查可提高房颤检出率（RR 1.76）和口服抗凝药启动率（RR 1.78），但未显著降低卒中、死亡或大出血风险。

室性心律失常（12）

  • Intended bilateral cardiac sympathetic denervation in children and young adults with severe adrenergically mediated ventricular arrhythmias: a single-centre experience.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-11-19
    儿童及年轻成人双侧心脏交感神经去神经术可行，1年恶性室性心律失常无事件生存率95.8%，3年89.4%，手术相关并发症低。
  • The influence of genotype on clinical outcomes in dilated cardiomyopathy.
    Eur Heart J Valvular Struct Heart Dis · 2026-11-19
    在484例扩张型心肌病患者中，基因型分层显示恶性室性心律失常或终末期心衰风险呈等级差异：基因阴性最低，LMNA最高（发生率比4.4），RBM20次之（2.7），提示基因型可改善风险预测。
  • SCN5A cardiomyopathy presenting with ventricular arrhythmia and conduction disease: A novel splice variant.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Right atrium-to-left ventricle access guided by computed tomography merged with 3-dimensional mapping for ventricular tachycardia ablation in a patient with mechanical aortic and mitral valves.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Management of sensing issues with an extravascular and subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator in a patient with polymorphic ventricular tachycardia: A case report.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Approach to epicardial access for ventricular tachycardia ablation in a patient with an extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Pacemaker-induced ventricular fibrillation after transcatheter aortic valve replacement: Co-occurrence of proarrhythmic electrophysiological phenomena.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • From mitochondria to arrhythmia: Rare phenotype of mitochondrial encephalomyopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes presenting with long QT type 3 pattern.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Moderator band ventricular tachycardia causing reversible cardiomyopathy in a child.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Inappropriate ventricular fibrillation detection by extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Fluoroscopy-guided transatrial access to the left ventricle for ventricular tachycardia ablation in a patient with dual mechanical valves.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Sex Disparities in Outcomes and Safety of Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation With Percutaneous Mechanical Circulatory Support.
    JACC Adv · 2026-11-19

器械治疗（9）

  • Quantitative membranous septum area assessment with advanced three-dimensional CT visualization with a mixed reality-capable device.
    Eur Heart J Digit Health · 2026-11-19
    新型3D全息软件测量主动脉瓣复合体解剖可行且可重复，与基准软件一致性高，并能评估膜部室间隔面积。
  • Case Report: Rupture of multiple perforating branches and fatal giant interventricular septal hematoma: a severe complication of left bundle branch area pacing.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-19
    67岁终末期心衰患者行LBBAP时发生多支室间隔穿支破裂致巨大室间隔血肿，虽经ECMO等抢救仍死亡。
  • Transvenous defibrillator coil in the coronary sinus combined with conduction system pacing: Retrospective review of 4 patients.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Coronary interventional equipment and a retrograde approach as the sole toolset for recanalization of chronic total subclavian vein occlusion after cardiac resynchronization therapy: A two-case technical report.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Helix-based retrieval of an embolized atrial leadless pacemaker from the pulmonary artery.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Feasibility and procedural considerations of a helix-fixation leadless pacemaker implantation in patients with left ventricular assist devices.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Multiple right ventricular pseudoaneurysms after helix-fixation leadless pacemaker implantation.
    HeartRhythm Case Rep · 2026-11-19
  • Variability and Drivers of Battery Longevity in Contemporary Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Systems Across Geographic Regions.
    JACC Asia · 2026-11-19
    当代ICD/CRT-D电池寿命因地理区域而异，亚太和欧洲长于北美，差异可达2.0年，与起搏负担、随访强度和放电相关。
  • Pooled Periprocedural and Short-Term Outcomes After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement With Contemporary Self-Expanding Valves: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    Struct Heart · 2026-11-19
    汇总52项研究、21349例重度主动脉瓣狭窄患者显示，Navitor与Evolut PRO/PRO+/FX两款新型自膨胀瓣膜TAVR术后器械成功率高、30天死亡率低、1年血流动力学良好，但轻度瓣周漏与新起搏器植入仍常见。

遗传与基础（7）

  • Right Ventricular Cardiomyocyte Dysfunction and Arrhythmogenesis in a Bleomycin-induced Mouse Model of Group 3 Pulmonary Hypertension.
    Am J Physiol Heart Circ Physiol · 2026-11-19
    在博来霉素诱导的小鼠3组肺动脉高压模型中，右心室心肌细胞兴奋-收缩耦联受损，表现为舒张期钙升高、钙瞬变和收缩幅度降低，且右心室心律失常易感性增加，而左心室不受累。
  • Genetic variants of transthyretin amyloidosis with cardiomyopathy associated with low sensitivity to bone scintigraphy: a systematic review.
    Amyloid · 2026-11-19
    在遗传性ATTR-CA中，13种TTR变异与骨闪烁显像低/无摄取相关，阴性扫描不能排除心脏受累。
  • NLRP3 inflammasome-driven inflammation as a cause of atrial fibrillation: potential synergistic inhibition of the NLRP3 via upstream magnesium repletion and targeting NLRP3 with a downstream inhibitor.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-19
    房颤可能是一种由NLRP3炎症小体驱动的自身炎症性疾病，联合口服镁补充与NLRP3抑制剂或可降低房颤负荷。
  • Placental transcriptomes differ in human pregnancies complicated by severe fetal left heart obstruction.
    JCI Insight · 2026-11-19
    严重胎儿左侧梗阻性心脏病变妊娠的足月胎盘转录组存在独特改变，即使组织学正常，提示心脏-胎盘轴参与发病。
  • De Rol van het Epigenoom in de Ontwikkeling van Atriumfibrilleren bij de Mens Ontrafelen met behulp van Single-Nucleus Omics
    Lirias · 2026-11-19
    本研究利用单核多组学技术揭示心房颤动与结构重构在细胞和调控层面的重叠与差异，并鉴定JMJD1C为成纤维细胞活化的功能调控因子。
  • Shared genetic architecture between digestive infectious diseases and cardiovascular diseases: a genome-wide cross-trait analysis
    medRxiv · 2026-11-19
    消化系统感染性疾病（尤其肠道感染）与心血管疾病存在显著遗传相关性，孟德尔随机化支持肠道感染易感性增加心律失常、心梗、房颤和缺血性心脏病风险。
  • Spliceosome gene mutations synergize with anthracyclines to amplify atrial fibrillation risk in hematologic malignancies: a multicenter cohort study with discovery and validation.
    BMC Med · 2026-11-18
    在血液恶性肿瘤患者中，剪接体基因突变是AF的独立预测因子，且与蒽环类药物暴露协同增加AF风险，机制可能涉及单核细胞驱动的炎症和心房重构。

item.title: 2026-11-19 心脏电生理日报（24 篇）
item.description:
共 24 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（16）

  • Low-Voltage Area-Guided Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
    Ann Noninvasive Electrocardiol · 2026-11-18
    在持续性房颤患者中，低电压区（LVA）指导的消融较非LVA指导策略可减少房性心律失常复发（RR 0.77）和重复消融（RR 0.69），但效应受IDEAL-AF试验影响大且异质性较高。
  • Vernakalant Versus Other Antiarrhythmic Drugs for Pharmacological Cardioversion of Recent-Onset Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis With Trial Sequential Analysis.
    Cardiol Rev · 2026-11-18
    在近期发病房颤的药物复律中，静脉维纳卡兰较其他抗心律失常药提高转复窦律成功率（OR 2.52），主要驱动于与胺碘酮的比较，并缩短转复时间、减少电复律需求。
  • Beta-Blocker Management in Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Treated With Mavacamten: A Practical Approach.
    Cardiology · 2026-11-18
    综述指出β受体阻滞剂不削弱mavacamten对梗阻和症状的疗效，但可能因变时性限制降低运动耐量，建议按临床指征重新评估是否继续使用。
  • Atrial Fibrillation and Subclinical Thyroid Dysfunction: Revisiting an Underrecognized Association - A Narrative Review.
    Clin Med Insights Cardiol · 2026-11-18
    叙述性综述提示亚临床甲亢（尤其TSH<0.1 mIU/L）与房颤风险升高相关，而亚临床甲减与房颤的关联证据较弱，治疗能否预防房颤仍缺乏大型试验证据。
  • Cannabis-related disorders, hospitalization, and cardiovascular outcomes in patients with heart failure: A real-world propensity-matched cohort study.
    Clin Res Cardiol · 2026-11-18
    在倾向匹配的心衰队列中，大麻相关障碍与1年全因住院风险（57.5% vs 45.1%，HR 1.468）及全因死亡、卒中、心梗风险升高相关。
  • Development and validation of a machine learning model for heart failure in older patients with atrial fibrillation.
    Digit Health · 2026-11-18
    在1989例住院老年房颤患者中，基于16个变量构建的XGBoost模型识别住院期间临床判定的心衰，测试集AUROC为0.737，校准良好，具有中等区分度和较高可解释性。
  • Smartphone mechanocardiography used for post-ablation home monitoring to detect atrial fibrillation recurrence: usability, adherence, and re-ablation.
    Eur Heart J Digit Health · 2026-11-18
    智能手机心机图（MCG）用于房颤消融术后家庭监测可行且依从性高，早期房颤复发常见（3个月内40%），并与12个月内再消融显著相关。
  • Digital virtual ward vs. standard of care for acute atrial fibrillation: a single centre non-randomized pilot comparison of clinical outcomes and cost.
    Eur Heart J Digit Health · 2026-11-18
    在倾向评分匹配的急性房颤虚拟病房与标准住院比较中，90天不良结局无显著差异（HR 0.61），但虚拟病房组再入院后急诊床位日更高，探索性分析显示其直接成本更低。
  • Evaluation of the ESC Guideline based risk stratification of syncope patients in the emergency department A post-hoc analysis of the SYNERGY-trial.
    Europace · 2026-11-18
    在急诊晕厥患者中，基于ESC指南的RISC评分可有效排除心源性晕厥，AUC达0.928，2分阈值阴性预测值99.5%。
  • Venous Vascular Closure System Versus Conventional Figure of Eight Suture Following Single Shot Device Pulmonary Vein Isolation: The VASC-AF Study.
    Europace · 2026-11-18
    在单次消融房颤肺静脉隔离患者中，生物可吸收血管闭合系统较传统8字缝合显著缩短术后恢复时间并减少轻微血管并发症，主要安全终点相当。
  • Controversy: Adjunctive ablation lesions are needed beyond pulmonary vein isolation in treating persistent atrial fibrillation: Pro and Contra
    Europace · 2026-11-18
    持续性房颤中，经验性附加消融的随机试验结果不一致或中性，PIFPAF-PFA试验未显示附加后壁隔离显著减少房性快速性心律失常复发，但复发曲线分离提示需重新审视终点定义。
  • Evaluation of risk factors for tricuspid regurgitation prior to cardiac pacemaker.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-18
    在缓慢性心律失常起搏器植入患者中，术前三尖瓣反流严重程度受女性、心衰、持续性房颤和肺动脉高压影响，且与术后再住院和心功能恶化相关，但中重度反流患者术后反流可能改善。
  • miR-6891 predicts atrial fibrillation recurrence and promotes fibroblast dysfunction.
    J Thromb Thrombolysis · 2026-11-18
    血清miR-6891在房颤患者中上调，可独立预测消融术后复发，并通过靶向PTEN介导心房成纤维细胞功能障碍。
  • Clinical, Electrophysiological Profile and Outcomes in Patients With Permanent Junctional Reciprocating Tachycardia.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-18
    亚洲最大单中心PJRT队列显示，射频消融初始成功率95.8%，长期随访100%无心律失常复发，但需警惕冠状动脉痉挛或闭塞等罕见严重并发症。
  • Inverse Association Between Triglyceride-Glucose Index and Ischemic Stroke in critically ill patients with Atrial Fibrillation
    Research Square · 2026-11-18
    在重症房颤患者中，较高的TyG指数与较低的缺血性卒中风险独立相关，该反向关联在外部队列中得到验证，但TyG单独预测价值有限。
  • Association between LDL-C/HDL-C ratio and atrial fibrillation risk in chronic heart failure patients.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-17
    在1294例慢性心衰患者中，LDL-C/HDL-C比值与房颤患病率独立负相关，比值越高房颤越少，该易得指标或有助于筛选需加强房颤筛查的患者。

室性心律失常（4）

  • Blocking the Sympathetic Storm: Adjunctive Left Stellate Ganglion Block for Refractory Ventricular Tachycardia After Inferolateral Myocardial Infarction.
    Cureus · 2026-11-18
    53岁下侧壁心梗后顽固性室速患者，在药物和电复律无效后，超声引导下左星状神经节阻滞使室速终止，24小时内拔管。
  • Right ventricular apical hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with asymmetric left ventricular septal involvement decades after heart transplant: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-11-18
    一例30岁女性心脏移植受者（移植时5周龄）在移植后数十年出现右室心尖肥厚型心肌病伴左室间隔非对称性受累，因广泛晚期钆增强植入皮下ICD进行猝死一级预防，随访16个月无症状。
  • Deep learning-based strain echocardiography adds prognostic value in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
    Eur Heart J Imaging Methods Pract · 2026-11-18
    基于深度学习的应变超声心动图可自动测量GLS和MD，在HFrEF患者中预测室性心律失常，联合指标风险比达6.98。
  • Incessant Ventricular Tachycardia in Infant With Structurally Normal Heart: Is it Truly Benign or a Old Wives' Tale.
    Sage Open Pediatr · 2026-11-18
    新生儿无休止特发性室速可导致心力衰竭和左室功能不全，早期诊断对改善预后至关重要。

器械治疗（1）

  • A temporary fix: assessing the safety, efficacy, and various applications of temporary externalized pacemakers.
    Proc (Bayl Univ Med Cent) · 2026-11-18
    单中心回顾性研究显示，100例接受临时主动固定起搏器（TAF-PM）的患者中38%成功脱离起搏且未植入永久起搏器，并发症率低（电极脱位3%），无感染、穿孔等严重事件。

遗传与基础（2）

  • Polycystin Dysfunction and Cardiac Electrical Abnormalities in ADPKD.
    Am J Nephrol · 2026-11-18
    综述指出ADPKD中PKD1/PKD2变异所致多囊蛋白功能异常通过钙稳态失衡、机械转导障碍与线粒体功能障碍导致心脏电重构，临床表现为QT/QTc延长、左室肥厚、AF及室性心律失常。
  • Myocardial Hmgcs2-Driven Ketogenesis Promotes Atrial Fibrillation in Diabetes.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-11-18
    糖尿病小鼠心脏Hmgcs2上调驱动酮体生成，消耗心肌能量并增加房颤易感性，抑制Hmgcs2可减轻糖尿病相关房颤。

其他（1）

  • Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning for Wearable Arrhythmia Detection: A Comprehensive Trade-off Analysis
    Research Square · 2026-11-18
    在可穿戴设备心律失常检测中，联邦学习在无隐私噪声时准确率可达95.0%，但差分隐私机制是主要限制因素，ε=0.1-10时准确率仅58.4%-79.2%且方差大。

item.title: 2026-11-18 心脏电生理日报（30 篇）
item.description:
共 30 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（18）

  • Controversy: Adjunctive ablation lesions are needed beyond pulmonary vein isolation in treating persistent atrial fibrillation: Pro and Contra
    Europace · 2026-11-18
    持续性房颤在PVI基础上追加经验性消融的随机试验结果不一致，PIFPAF-PFA试验中后壁隔离未显著减少房性快速性心律失常复发，但复发曲线分离提示需重新审视终点定义。
  • Comparison of Cryoballoon and Pulsed Field Ablation in Patients with Symptomatic Atrial Fibrillation: First 6-Month Experience.
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-11-17
    单中心100例症状性房颤患者比较冷冻球囊与脉冲场消融行PVI，6个月房性心律失常复发率无显著差异（8.9% vs 12.7%），PFA手术时间更短。
  • BiodEgradable soaked Amiodarone paTch use for the prevention of Atrial Fibrillation after cardiac surgery (The BEAT-AF Trial): Rationale and Design.
    CJC Open · 2026-11-17
    BEAT-AF试验旨在评估心脏术后心外膜应用可降解胺碘酮贴片预防术后房颤的疗效与安全性，计划随机500例以上患者。
  • Clinical Differences in Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Open Thoracic Surgery.
    CJC Open · 2026-11-17
    开胸术后房颤（POAF）患者远期房颤发生率较高，但复发率因手术类型和POAF天数而异，食管手术后复发率最低。
  • Hypoxic Burden in Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Risk Phenotype for AF Ablation and Ventricular Vulnerability: Hypoxic Burden and Arrhythmia Risk.
    Clin Cardiol · 2026-11-17
    综述指出，睡眠呼吸暂停相关缺氧负荷可能补充AHI用于房颤消融风险表型，但现有证据不足以建立氧合阈值或治疗算法。
  • Coronary Embolism Followed by Concurrent Superior Mesenteric Artery and Infrarenal Aortic Embolism in Atrial Fibrillation Despite Full Anticoagulation and Dual Antiplatelet Therapy: A Fatal Case of Acute Mesenteric Ischemia.
    Cureus · 2026-11-17
    52岁房颤女性在充分抗凝及双联抗血小板治疗下，4天内相继发生冠脉、肠系膜、肾及主动脉栓塞，最终死于不可逆肠坏死。
  • Intravascular Hemolysis and the Spectrum of Tissue Injury Following Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review of Clinical Markers, Catheter Designs, and Renal Outcomes.
    Cureus · 2026-11-17
    PFA治疗房颤可导致显著但可预测的血管内溶血，严重肾损伤罕见，溶血和肾损伤程度与手术剂量、导管设计及水化状态相关。
  • The Electrocardiogram as a Preventive Biomarker: From Conventional Risk Markers to Actionable Artificial Intelligence - A Narrative Review.
    Eur J Prev Cardiol · 2026-11-17
    本叙述性综述指出，AI-ECG在检测和预测心血管疾病方面有潜力，但将其转化为可改善结局的预防工具仍需明确目标人群、外部验证和可行的工作流程。
  • Progress in animal models of right atrial fibrillation substrate associated with chronic hypoxia and pulmonary hypertension.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-17
    综述提出右房房颤基质证据的三层框架，强调现有慢性缺氧和肺动脉高压动物模型对右房主导性致心律失常基质及维持期作用的直接证据不足。
  • Potential Association Between Antibiotics and Atrial Fibrillation: A Review of Current Evidence and Mechanistic Insights.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-11-17
    抗生素暴露与房颤的关联证据有限且异质，现有数据主要来自观察性研究和药物警戒分析，尚不能确立因果关系，需控制感染的对照研究进一步验证。
  • Epicardial Pulsed Field Ablation Across the Intact Pericardium: Feasibility, Safety Margins, and Tissue Selectivity in a Porcine Model.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-17
    在猪模型中，经完整心包行心外膜脉冲场消融可产生可预测的病灶，但标准剂量真实坏死范围小，高剂量则导致透壁坏死和左室功能下降。
  • Association of atrial fibrillation with mortality across quantitatively assessed tricuspid regurgitation severity.
    J Echocardiogr · 2026-11-17
    在定量评估的三尖瓣反流队列中，房颤与全因死亡无独立关联，但分类变量分析提示房颤与严重三尖瓣反流可能存在交互作用，该发现仅为探索性。
  • Deep Learning With Longitudinal Electrocardiograms Predicts Atrial Fibrillation Better Than a Single Electrocardiogram
    JACC Advances · 2026-11-17
  • Epicardial atrial flutter ablation in a patient with esophageal achalasia: CT-based exclusion of left atrial appendage thrombus.
    Kardiol Pol · 2026-11-17
  • Clinical outcomes of apixaban in patients with atrial fibrillation and very high thromboembolic risk (CHA₂DS₂-VASc ≥5): a retrospective cohort study
    Research Square · 2026-11-17
    在CHA₂DS₂-VASc≥5的房颤患者中，艾多沙班治疗与更高的院内死亡率相关，但血栓栓塞事件增加仅见于有卒中史者，且出血风险无显著差异。
  • Early systolic blood pressure trajectories and risks of 30-day mortality and new-onset atrial fibrillation in critically ill patients receiving dialysis: A retrospective cohort study.
    Sci Prog · 2026-11-17
    在2716例接受透析的危重患者中，早期收缩压轨迹分为4类，其中持续低血压型占59.5%且30天死亡和新发房颤风险最高，而中度下降型和高降反弹型风险较低。
  • The gut-heart axis in atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis of microbiome composition and trimethylamine N-oxide concentration.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-16
    房颤患者TMAO水平显著升高，但肠道微生物α多样性与对照组无显著差异，特定菌属丰度呈一致性改变。
  • Impact of contact-pressure based Hotballoon ablation of atrial fibrillation.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-16
    基于球囊接触压力（BCP）指导的HotBalloon房颤消融可提高单次肺静脉隔离成功率，LSPV阈值40 mmHg、非LSPV阈值35 mmHg，且安全性良好。

室性心律失常（1）

  • Electrophysiological Markers in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Enhancing Sudden Cardiac Death Risk Prediction with Index of Cardiac Electrophysiological Balance and Its Corrected Variant
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-11-17
    在127例肥厚型心肌病患者中，ICEB和ICEBc显著低于对照组，对危及生命心律失常和非持续性室速的预测优于传统指标和ESC SCD风险评分，Base+ICEB模型AUC达0.79。

器械治疗（9）

  • Postimplantation Activity Restrictions and Shoulder Dysfunction After Pacemaker Implantation.
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-11-17
  • Reply to the Letter to the Editor: "Postimplantation Activity Restrictions and Shoulder Dysfunction After Pacemaker Implantation".
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-11-17
  • Adherence to Guidelines in Patients With Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction Before Defibrillator Implantation.
    CJC Open · 2026-11-17
    在364例因一级预防植入ICD的HFrEF患者中，植入时仅约10%达到GDMT目标剂量，术后12个月BB与MRA优化明显改善，但ACEI/ARB/ARNI未变。
  • Severe Hypothyroidism Causing Reversible Pacing Failure: A Case Report and Literature Review.
    Cureus · 2026-11-17
    一例66岁女性因严重甲状腺功能减退导致起搏器感知和起搏功能异常，甲状腺激素替代治疗后起搏器功能恢复正常。
  • Implantation Technique, Continuous Implant Geometry, and Longitudinal Low-Voltage Impedance After Subcutaneous Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Implantation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-17
    S-ICD植入技术影响纵向低电压阻抗轨迹，皮下植入较肌间植入阻抗更高且随时间差异增大，连续测量的线圈-胸骨距离与慢性阻抗独立相关。
  • Incidence of Pacing-Induced Cardiomyopathy in Active-Fixation Leadless Pacemakers.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-17
    在高心室起搏负荷（≥20%）患者中，主动固定无导线起搏器植入后10.5%发生起搏诱导性心肌病，且PICM是心衰住院的强预测因子（HR 6.9）。
  • Safety of Mohs Micrographic Surgery in Patients With Surgically Implanted Medical Devices.
    J Clin Aesthet Dermatol · 2026-11-17
    综述证据支持在采取适当预防措施下，植入心脏起搏器、ICD、脑深部刺激器和人工耳蜗的患者可安全接受Mohs显微描记手术，双极电外科优于单极，电灼的电磁干扰风险最低。
  • Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance to Guide Defibrillator Implantation for LVEF of 36% to 50%: Research Summary
    JAMA · 2026-11-17
  • Initial real-world experience with the commercially available OmniaSecure defibrillation lead for left bundle branch-optimized cardiac resynchronization therapy (LOT-CRT).
    Kardiol Pol · 2026-11-17

遗传与基础（1）

  • Novel markers for atrial substrate characterization: implications on atrial fibrillation risk stratification
    Curr Opin Cardiol · 2026-11-17
    综述指出，心电图指标、左房容积与应变、CT左房壁特征、LGE-CMR、高密度电解剖标测、循环标志物及基因分型等多模态心房基质标志物可互补评估电、结构、机械与血流重构，有望改善AF发生、进展及节律控制治疗结局的预测。

其他（1）

  • Conduction System Pacing versus Conventional Right Ventricular Pacing After Cardiac Surgery - A Multicenter Cohort Study.
    Europace · 2026-11-17

item.title: 2026-11-17 心脏电生理日报（27 篇）
item.description:
共 27 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（10）

  • From interpretation to implementation in cardiovascular care.
    Acta Cardiol · 2026-11-16
    本期社论指出，将证据转化为更好的临床结局既需要严谨解读研究，也需要有效的实施策略，所涉研究涵盖冷冻消融、心衰重构、SGLT2抑制剂应用等多个心血管领域。
  • Prognostic Value of the Electrical Risk Score for In-Hospital and 1-Year Mortality in Acute Decompensated Heart Failure.
    Ann Noninvasive Electrocardiol · 2026-11-16
    在急性失代偿性心衰住院患者中，电风险评分（ERS）≥4分与院内死亡和1年死亡独立相关，但对1年死亡的区分能力仅中等（AUC 0.622），再住院率无差异。
  • Cardiac Rhythm Disorders and Chronic Occupational Exposure to Pollutants: A Systematic Review.
    Cardiovasc Toxicol · 2026-11-16
    系统综述提示慢性职业暴露于铅、二硫化碳、部分溶剂及可吸入颗粒物与房颤等心律失常风险相关，机制可能涉及细胞毒性、氧化应激和炎症。
  • Biatrial Versus Left Atrial Maze Ablation During Cardiac Valve Surgery for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: The ABLATION Trial.
    Circulation · 2026-11-16
    在持续性房颤接受风湿性瓣膜手术的患者中，双心房迷宫消融在12个月无房性快速性心律失常方面优于左心房迷宫消融（78.7% vs 68.6%），且永久起搏器植入非劣效。
  • Surgical Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation.
    Circulation · 2026-11-16
    综述指出，微创Cox-Maze IV术后5年无房性心律失常生存率可达85%~95%，杂交消融约60%~70%，均优于单纯胸腔镜心外膜消融（35%~45%）或单次导管消融（30%~35%）。
  • Initial Experience with Bachmann Bundle Pacing Lead Implantation as a Rhythm Control Strategy in Atrial Fibrillation.
    Europace · 2026-11-16
    在持续性房颤患者中，基于解剖和电生理标志的Bachmann束起搏（BBP）植入可行，窦律恢复后11/12例确认夺获，BBP联合LBBP或可支持节律控制策略。
  • Left atrial pressure and arrhythmia recurrence after pulmonary vein isolation - more than a dichotomous threshold.
    Europace · 2026-11-16
  • Predictors and Long-term Prognosis of Silent Cerebral Embolism After Catheter Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation.
    Europace · 2026-11-16
  • Anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation in adults with advanced kidney disease: UK kidney association clinical practice guideline.
    BMC Nephrol · 2026-11-15
    UKKA指南针对晚期CKD合并AF患者，因DOAC试验排除CrCl<30 ml/min人群，抗凝决策困难，指南提供了包括不抗凝、DOAC使用、监测及左心耳封堵在内的最佳实践建议。
  • Preoperative C‑reactive protein‑to‑albumin ratio as a predictor of postoperative atrial fibrillation after coronary artery bypass grafting.
    J Cardiothorac Surg · 2026-11-15
    术前C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值（CAR）是CABG术后房颤的强独立预测因子，每单位升高OR为1.50，AUC达0.9713。

室性心律失常（7）

  • Electrophysiological Markers in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Enhancing Sudden Cardiac Death Risk Prediction with Index of Cardiac Electrophysiological Balance and Its Corrected Variant
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-11-17
    在127例肥厚型心肌病患者中，ICEB与ICEBc在致命性心律失常及非持续性室速组显著降低，预测效能优于传统复极参数与ESC SCD风险评分。
  • Successful percutaneous intervention for post-operative coronary artery stenosis in a child: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-11-16
    7岁患儿在主动脉根部置换及右冠状动脉再植术后出现近段RCA严重狭窄，虽无症状但负荷CMR和运动试验证实可逆性缺血，经成人介入心脏病学家协作成功行冠脉支架PCI，恢复冠脉灌注并改善功能。
  • Sex-specific challenges and psychosocial adaptation in women with implantable cardioverter defibrillators.
    Nursing · 2026-11-16
    女性ICD植入者面临更多并发症、心理困扰和体像担忧，生活质量下降，但临床试验代表性不足且接受ICD治疗率低于男性，需性别特异性干预。
  • Causal Peak Refinement Reduces Timing Error of a Classical R-Peak Detector Across Beat Morphologies
    Research Square · 2026-11-16
    因果峰值精炼阶段将经典R波检测器的平均绝对时间误差从25.8 ms降至6.0 ms，±50 ms平均F1从92.5%升至98.0%，但在室扑和未匹配室早记录中无效。
  • PREGNANCY OUTCOMES IN A CONTEMPORARY COHORT OF WOMEN WITH REPAIRED TETRALOGY OF FALLOT.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-11-15
    在当代rTOF女性队列中，妊娠期母体心脏事件风险较低（6.8%），主要为室上性心律失常；但低出生体重（22%）和早产（11%）仍较常见，且与孕前右心室射血分数（RVEF）较低相关。
  • Diabetes mellitus and the risk of sudden cardiac death in patients with and without coronary artery disease.
    Cardiovasc Diabetol · 2026-11-15
    在22,395例冠脉造影患者中，糖尿病与SCD或SCD等危事件风险增加38%相关，且不依赖阻塞性CAD；但非SCA死亡竞争风险更高。
  • Refractory ventricular tachyarrhythmia following a suicidal massive caffeine overdose: a case report and review of emergency management.
    J Med Case Rep · 2026-11-15
    16岁女孩自杀性摄入10.8g咖啡因后出现难治性室性心动过速，急诊间歇性血液透析后恶性心律失常迅速终止并完全康复。

器械治疗（3）

  • Best Evidence Summary of Phase II Exercise-Based Cardiac Rehabilitation for Patients with Dilated Cardiomyopathy After Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy.
    J Multidiscip Healthc · 2026-11-16
    该证据总结纳入28篇文献、汇总42条证据，覆盖DCM患者CRT术后II期运动康复的12个主题，但多数证据来自泛心衰人群，DCM-CRT专属证据仍有限。
  • Conduction system pacing vs biventricular pacing in heart failure patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy: an updated grade-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
    Expert Rev Med Devices · 2026-11-15
    在心脏再同步治疗中，传导系统起搏较双心室起搏可缩短QRS并提高6个月LVEF，但12个月LVEF改善反而劣于双心室起搏，临床硬终点无差异。
  • Intraoperative Recognition and Management of Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy Defibrillator Lead Dysfunction During Left Ventricular Assist Device Implantation.
    J Cardiothorac Vasc Anesth · 2026-11-15

影像与标测（1）

  • Early Left Bundle Branch Pacing for Complete Left Bundle Branch Block and Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction of 36%-50%: The EARLY-RESYNC Randomized Trial.
    Europace · 2026-11-16
    在完全性左束支传导阻滞且LVEF 36%-50%的患者中，早期左束支起搏联合GDMT较单用GDMT显著改善6个月LVEF（差异7.4%）。

遗传与基础（4）

  • KRT16 From Diverse Tumors Induces Atrial Remodeling and Fibrillation via Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition.
    Adv Sci (Weinh) · 2026-11-16
    多种癌症通过共享循环因子KRT16诱导心房内皮间质转化，独立于抗癌治疗直接促进心房重构和房颤易感性。
  • Novel markers for atrial substrate characterization: implications on atrial fibrillation risk stratification.
    Curr Opin Cardiol · 2026-11-16
    综述指出，多模态心房基质特征（电、结构、机械、血流动力学重构）可能改善房颤发生、进展及节律控制治疗结局的风险分层，但临床转化需标准化方法与前瞻性验证。
  • Severe neonatal long QT syndrome type 3 treated with genotype-directed therapy and early left cardiac sympathetic denervation: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-11-16
    新生儿严重长QT综合征3型经基因导向治疗及早期左心交感神经去神经术，虽需ICD但心律失常负荷逐步改善。
  • Aspirin Use May Increase Atrial Fibrillation Risk: A Mendelian Randomization Analysis.
    Int J Genomics · 2026-11-16
    孟德尔随机化分析提示，遗传预测的阿司匹林使用与房颤风险升高存在因果关系（OR 1.96，95%CI 1.10–3.47，P=0.021）。

其他（2）

  • Sex Differences in QT Interval and Beat-to-Beat Temporal QT Variability at Rest and After Submaximal Exercise in Young Adults With and Without Obesity: A Cross-Sectional Study.
    Cureus · 2026-11-16
    肥胖年轻女性在静息和次极量运动后单导联逐搏QT变异性均高于肥胖男性，提示肥胖状态下心室复极稳定性存在性别差异。
  • Flexibility in Device Sizing with a Next-Generation LAA Occluder in the VERITAS Study.
    Europace · 2026-11-16

item.title: 2026-11-16 心脏电生理日报（16 篇）
item.description:
共 16 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（12）

  • Functional health literacy and medication adherence in atrial fibrillation patients.
    Am Heart J Plus · 2026-11-15
    在伊朗407例接受口服抗凝治疗的房颤患者中，功能性健康素养是服药依从性的独立预测因子，且关联主要由信息应用维度驱动。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Aneurysm Presenting With Atrial Fibrillation in a Young Woman: A Case Report.
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-11-15
    25岁女性左心耳瘤合并房颤及呼吸困难，多模态影像确诊后行手术切除，病理为良性，6个月随访无复发及血栓栓塞事件。
  • Atrial Fibrillation During Zanubrutinib Treatment in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia With a Historical Ibrutinib Control.
    EJHaem · 2026-11-15
    在679例接受泽布替尼治疗的慢性淋巴细胞白血病患者中，中位治疗15.5个月期间房颤发生率仅1.33%，明显低于历史伊布替尼对照组的11.9%。
  • Pulmonary Vein Reconnection Burden and Extra-Pulmonary Vein Ablation During Second Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation in the Pre-Pulsed-Field Ablation Era: A Multicenter Registry.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-15
    在二次房颤消融中，多支肺静脉重连并再隔离与较低的房性心律失常复发风险独立相关（HR 0.69），尤其在无有症状心衰患者中更明显。
  • COMPARATIVE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF ANTICOAGULATION STRATEGIES FOR ELECTRICAL CARDIOVERSION OF ATRIAL FIBRILLATION: A COMPREHENSIVE SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS OF RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIALS AND PRIMARY STUDIES
    The Indonesian Journal of General Medicine · 2026-11-15
    在房颤电复律中，NOAC与VKA相比卒中/体循环栓塞风险相似，但大出血更少；围术期抗凝较无抗凝显著降低血栓栓塞风险。
  • Hybrid surgical-electrophysiological epicardial cryoablation for ventricular tachycardia storm from a deep intramural substrate in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-11-14
    一例HCM合并药物难治性VT电风暴患者，因深部壁内基质且经皮心外膜途径不可行，采用杂交外科-电生理心外膜冷冻消融成功终止VT，随访1年无复发。
  • Evaluation of a novel transseptal puncture device for use in cardiac procedures requiring left atrial access.
    Future Cardiol · 2026-11-14
    新型房间隔穿刺装置Protaryx在5例首人体研究中实现快速靶向卵圆窝穿刺，零不良事件，后续结构性心脏介入100%成功。
  • Atrial fibrillation status and functional capacity in transthyretin cardiac amyloid cardiomyopathy.
    Int J Cardiol Heart Vasc · 2026-11-14
    在转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变心肌病（ATTR-CM）患者中，房颤状态与功能容量相关，阵发性房颤患者6分钟步行距离较无房颤者更低。
  • Association Between Echocardiographic Epicardial Adipose Tissue Thickness and Atrial Fibrillation in a Single-centre Pakistani Cohort.
    J Saudi Heart Assoc · 2026-11-14
    在巴基斯坦单中心队列中，超声心动图心外膜脂肪厚度每增加1mm，房颤患病风险独立增加60%（校正OR 1.60），且该关联不受左房容积指数影响。
  • The Europe-Asia-Pacific Divide in Atrial Fibrillation Management: Evidence, Practice, and Policy.
    JACC Asia · 2026-11-14
    本综述比较欧洲与亚太地区房颤管理六大领域，发现两地实践全面分歧，抗凝差距缩小但资金、电生理能力与数字可及性差异持续，且区域内差异不亚于区域间差异。
  • Management Strategies of Atrial Fibrillation Detected by Consumer Wearable Devices: A Systematic Review of Clinical Practice and Decision-Making.
    Methodist Debakey Cardiovasc J · 2026-11-14
    可穿戴设备检测的房颤管理策略缺乏共识，医生对抗凝阈值差异大，需前瞻性验证的临床路径。
  • Comprehensive overview of atrial fibrillation trends in Estonia: a population-based cohort study from 2017 to 2024.
    Open Heart · 2026-11-14

室性心律失常（1）

  • Real-World Performance of a Novel Wearable Cardioverter-Defibrillator System: Primary Results From a National Prospective Post-Approval Registry Study (ACE-PAS).
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-15
    ASSURE可穿戴除颤器在真实世界21612例患者中，VT/VF电击转复成功率100%，不适当电击发生率0.0065/患者月，患者依从性高。

器械治疗（2）

  • DNP Final Report: IMPROVING CLINICAL PROFICIENCY IN PACEMAKER INTERROGATION THROUGH STRUCTURED EDUCATION AND SIMULATION
    Scholar Works at UT Tyler (The University of Texas at Tyler) · 2026-11-15
    结构化教育与情景模拟使护士起搏器程控知识均分从24.4%升至72.0%、4周后达85.1%，胜任通过率由0%升至90%。
  • Emergencies at Sea: Sudden Death on Cruise Ships For the BELTRAN Study (BaskEtbaLl and soccer sTadiums: Registry on Automatic exterNal defibrillators).
    Curr Probl Cardiol · 2026-11-14
    邮轮猝死罕见（约1.8例/10万乘客），乘客以心血管性自然死亡为主，船员以创伤与自杀为主，船上AED配置与应急标准差异显著。

影像与标测（1）

  • Successful Non-Coronary Cusp Ablation in Type B Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome With an rS Pattern in Lead V1.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-11-15
    一例V1导联呈rS型的B型WPW综合征，电生理标测证实为旁His旁路，经无冠窦射频消融成功，提示心电图定位局限。

item.title: 2026-11-15 心脏电生理日报（35 篇）
item.description:
共 35 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（17）

  • Electrocardiographic Features in Patients with Neuromuscular Diseases: A Retrospective Analysis.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-11-14
    回顾性分析显示，DMD、BMD与DM1各有特征性心电图表现，DM1患者P波电压总和及P/QRS比值显著降低，提示心房肌病可能。
  • Chronological Magnetic Resonance Angiography Demonstration of Spontaneous Posterior Cerebral Artery Recanalization: Unmasking Cardioembolic Stroke and Postprandial Atrial Fibrillation Mislabeled as Dumping Syndrome.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-11-14
    63岁胃切除术后患者餐后心悸、头晕被误诊为倾倒综合征，后发生心源性栓塞性卒中，连续心电监测捕获阵发性房颤，抗凝治疗后3个月MRA显示大脑后动脉P1段完全再通。
  • Oral anticoagulation and cognitive outcomes in atrial fibrillation and Alzheimer's disease.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-11-14
  • Oral anticoagulation and cognitive outcomes in atrial fibrillation and Alzheimer's disease: considerations for longitudinal analyses.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-11-14
  • Device malfunction following epicardial pulsed field ablation using a focal dual energy ablation catheter in a patient with cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillator: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-11-14
    一例CRT-D患者在心外膜脉冲场消融后出现设备短暂重置为出厂设置，提示PFA与CIED存在潜在相互作用。
  • Efficacy and safety of low-power (20 W) catheter ablation for typical atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia: a prospective multicenter study.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-14
    低功率（20W）慢径路消融治疗典型AVNRT急性成功率99.5%，无永久性AV阻滞，年轻和基线心率快者需升级功率。
  • Aldosterone-Mediated Atrial Remodeling and Atrial Fibrillation: Molecular Mechanisms, Translational Insights and Implications for Cardiac Surgery.
    Int J Mol Sci · 2026-11-14
    醛固酮-MR信号可能通过氧化应激、炎症和纤维化促进房颤基质，但人类证据不一致；术前醛固酮与POAF相关，而MR拮抗剂围术期研究结果矛盾，尚不足以推荐醛固酮导向的POAF预防。
  • Influenza Infection, Newly Diagnosed Atrial Fibrillation, and One-Year Mortality in Hospitalized Adults: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    在住院成人中，流感病毒感染及既往流感疫苗接种均与新发房颤风险无关，但新发房颤与一年全因死亡风险升高68%相关。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Thrombus and Long-Term Clinical Outcomes in Anticoagulated Patients with Atrial Fibrillation and Atrial Flutter Referred for a Rhythm-Control Strategy: A Prospective Observational Cohort Study.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    在符合抗凝指征并接受TEE指导节律控制的AF/AFL患者中，AFL与AF相比，左心耳血栓、心血管死亡和心衰住院风险无显著独立差异，但AFL组后续消融比例更高，结论不能外推。
  • Systemic Inflammation and New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Acute Coronary Syndromes: A Single-Center Cohort Study.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    在100例ACS住院患者中，33%发生新发房颤；校正临床因素后仅CRP与NOAF独立相关（aOR 1.71），但模型判别力提升无统计学意义。
  • Serum Troponin and Procedural Duration Predict Delayed iASD Closure After Left Atrial Arrhythmia Ablation.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    射频消融术后血清肌钙蛋白升高与医源性房间隔缺损增大及6个月内延迟闭合相关，每单位升高使缺损存在风险增加两倍以上。
  • Apixaban Benefit in Subclinical Atrial Fibrillation Accounting for Competing Risks: A Reanalysis of the ARTESIA Trial.
    Am Heart J · 2026-11-13
    ARTESIA 再分析显示，将死亡与房颤进展按竞争风险处理时，阿哌沙班在亚临床房颤中 3.5 年绝对风险降低为 1.62%，低于传统删失法的 1.94%。
  • Impaired Left Atrial Contractile Strain and Late Pacemaker Implantation After the Cox-Maze Procedure Despite Maintained Sinus Rhythm.
    Ann Thorac Surg · 2026-11-13
    Cox-Maze术后1年虽维持窦性心律，但左房收缩应变受损（≥-1.8%）独立预测晚期起搏器植入，风险集中术后5年内。
  • Weekly Journal Scan: Less-than-OPTIMAl evidence for a shorter duration of dual antithrombotic therapy after percutaneous coronary intervention in patients with atrial fibrillation.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-11-13
  • Efficacy and safety of posterior wall isolation in persistent atrial fibrillation is modified by ablation energy source.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-11-13
    在持续性房颤中，后壁隔离（PWI）联合肺静脉隔离（PVI）减少心律失常复发的获益主要集中于冷冻球囊消融，射频和脉冲场消融未见明确获益，且不增加并发症。
  • Feasibility Assessment of Smartphone Camera-Based Atrial Fibrillation Detection Compared With Portable Electrocardiogram: Single-Patient Case Study.
    JMIR Form Res · 2026-11-13
    单例阵发性房颤患者的12天家庭监测中，智能手机面部摄像头rPPG与便携式ECG的节律分类一致率为91.3%（21/23），提示该无接触筛查技术可行但需更大样本验证。
  • Incidence and predictors of de novo atrial fibrillation in patients with heart failure undergoing continuous rhythm monitoring.
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-11-13
    在345例心衰患者中，长期连续心律监测显示新发房颤（>6分钟）发生率达24.9%，以持续性房颤为首发表现者死亡率显著更高，临床+结构+生物标志物联合模型可识别高危患者。

室性心律失常（6）

  • Fulminant Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Associated Myocarditis Presenting with Complete Atrioventricular Block After Combined Nivolumab and Ipilimumab Therapy: An Autopsy-Confirmed Case Report.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-11-14
    79岁转移性肾癌患者在接受纳武利尤单抗联合伊匹木单抗后14天出现完全性房室传导阻滞和高敏肌钙蛋白显著升高，尸检证实为暴发性免疫检查点抑制剂相关心肌炎，生前未识别。
  • The Safety and Feasibility of Monitoring Cardiac Arrhythmic Events Before and After Conversion From Conventional Intermittent Hemodialysis to Home Nocturnal Hemodialysis: A Pilot Study.
    Hemodial Int · 2026-11-14
    在低心脏风险的血液透析患者中，从传统间歇性血透转为家庭夜间血透后，植入式循环记录仪监测显示心律失常事件减少，且监测方案安全可行。
  • Erythrocyte Membrane β-Adrenoreactivity as a Systemic Adrenergic Phenotype Associated with Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia in Heart Failure Patients Undergoing Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy.
    Int J Mol Sci · 2026-11-14
    在HFrEF接受CRT-D的患者中，基线红细胞膜β-肾上腺素能反应性（EMA）与室性快速性心律失常（VTA）表型独立相关，但模型解释力有限。
  • Abuse of Anabolic-Androgenic Steroids: Molecular and Organ Dysfunctions-A Critical Narrative Review for Forensic Interpretation.
    Int J Mol Sci · 2026-11-14
    该叙述性综述指出，合成代谢雄激素类固醇滥用与内分泌抑制、红细胞增多、血脂异常、血压升高及左室结构功能改变相关，心电图复极延长和心率恢复受损，但个体致命性室性心律失常风险及尸检发现缺乏特异性，需结合毒理学与临床史综合判断。
  • Device-Derived Digital Biomarkers During SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy: A Secondary Analysis of the ERASe Trial.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    在ICD/CRT-D患者中，厄格列净治疗12个月未显著改变设备衍生的心率、心率变异性、体力活动及胸阻抗等参数，但样本量小致估计不精确。
  • Wearing Protection or Wearing Assumptions? A Critical Reappraisal of the Wearable Cardioverter-Defibrillator.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    综述指出可穿戴心律转复除颤器（WCD）虽广泛用于短暂性心脏性猝死风险患者，但缺乏改善预后的高质量证据，需选择性使用。

器械治疗（5）

  • Same ejection fraction, different patient: has the defibrillator outlived its own trial data?
    Eur Heart J · 2026-11-14
  • Predicting Persistent Left Ventricular Dysfunction After Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy Upgrade in Pacing-Induced Cardiomyopathy.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    在60例起搏诱导性心肌病（PICM）患者中，升级CRT后12个月82%患者LVEF恢复至>35%，基线LVEF低和左室扩大与持续严重左室功能不全相关，且后者长期死亡率更高。
  • One Catheter, Two Chambers: Feasibility and Acute Procedural Outcomes of Dual-Chamber Leadless Pacemaker Implantation with a Single Delivery Catheter.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    在102例双腔无导线起搏器植入中，单根递送导管完成两腔植入的成功率达98.0%，未增加并发症且降低耗材成本。
  • Tailored therapy for bradyarrhythmias: integrating leadless pacing, conduction system pacing, and cardioneuroablation.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-11-13
    本综述提出基于三种表型的个体化起搏治疗框架：高危低起搏负荷者选无导线起搏，高起搏负荷伴心室脆弱者选传导系统起搏，迷走神经介导者选心脏神经消融。
  • Changes in Ventilation Associated with Worsening Heart Failure in Ambulatory Patients.
    J Card Fail · 2026-11-13
    在CRT-D患者中，心衰事件前3天呼吸频率增快、潮气量降低，导致快速浅呼吸指数（RSBI）显著升高，提示RSBI可作为恶化心衰的敏感监测指标。

心力衰竭与代谢（2）

  • Cardioprotection and Heart Failure Management in Duchenne and Becker Muscular Dystrophies: A State-of-the-Art Review Across Pediatric and Transitional Age.
    J Clin Med · 2026-11-14
    DMD/BMD患者随呼吸支持延长寿命，扩张型心肌病成为主要死因；GLS可在射血分数下降前早期发现心肌损伤，支持早期启动心脏保护治疗并过渡至成人GDMT。
  • Economic Evaluations of Algorithm-Enabled Remote Monitoring of Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices: Systematic Review.
    J Med Internet Res · 2026-11-13
    针对CIED算法远程监测的经济学评价系统综述发现，部分研究显示其具成本效果甚至占优，但方法异质性大、证据确定性低。

遗传与基础（4）

  • ENO1-Related Signaling in Hypertension-Associated Atrial Remodeling: Evidence Implicating PI3K/AKT and NOX4.
    Cells · 2026-11-14
    高血压大鼠心房中ENO1持续上调，通过PI3K/AKT/NOX4通路促进心房重构和房颤易感性，抑制ENO1可减轻重构并缩短房颤持续时间。
  • Familial severe non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy with coexisting likely pathogenic BAG3 and FLNC variants: a case report.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-14
    一例40岁女性严重非缺血性扩张型心肌病，检出BAG3与FLNC双基因可能致病变异，家系呈现显著表型异质性，提示双基因致病需谨慎解读。
  • The Effect of S616L, a CPVT1-Associated Mutation, on the Stability and Structure of Human Cardiac RyR2.
    Int J Mol Sci · 2026-11-14
    CPVT1相关S616L突变通过改变hRyR2 N端结构域与桥接螺旋桨结构域界面残基构象，轻微削弱二者相互作用并促进结构域间开放，同时轻度增加N端片段的热稳定性。
  • Fight or Flight: A Multidisciplinary Approach to Diagnosis and Management of Mediastinal Paragangliomas.
    Ann Thorac Surg · 2026-11-13
    纵隔副神经节瘤在多学科卓越中心可安全切除，30天死亡率为零，但术后房性心律失常常见，切缘阳性或多灶病变者易局部复发。

其他（1）

  • An Intelligent Deep Learning Framework for Cardiac Arrhythmia Detection and Risk Prediction
    Research Square · 2026-11-14
    本研究提出一种结合1D CNN、BiLSTM和注意力机制的深度学习框架，用于ECG心搏五分类（AAMI标准）并附加风险分层，在MIT-BIH数据库上以0.6秒R峰窗口进行验证，目标为高分类准确率与可解释性。

item.title: 2026-11-14 心脏电生理日报（29 篇）
item.description:
共 29 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（16）

  • Robotic magnetic navigation for atrial fibrillation ablation in older adults: is chronological age still the main concern?
    Acta Cardiol · 2026-11-13
  • Establishment and Assessment of a Predictive Model for Atrial Fibrillation Complications Following Off-Pump Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting - A Retrospective Case-Control Study.
    Braz J Cardiovasc Surg · 2026-11-13
    非体外循环冠脉搭桥术后房颤发生率为24.04%，年龄、高血压、左房前后径>40mm、NYHA≥III级和术中血钾<4.5mmol/L是独立危险因素，据此构建的列线图预测模型区分度良好（AUC=0.919）。
  • Predictive Value of PET-Derived Myocardial Flow Reserve for New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation.
    Circ Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-11-13
    在无房颤史患者中，PET衍生的心肌血流储备（MFR）受损独立预测新发房颤，并提升风险预测能力。
  • The Impact of Lifestyle Interventions and Mental Health Management on Arrhythmias in Heart Failure.
    Curr Heart Fail Rep · 2026-11-13
    生活方式干预可减少房颤负荷并改善心衰患者功能状态，而心理健康干预虽改善心理福祉但未降低心律失常负荷或心血管结局。
  • Modified Posterior Wall Ablation in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: the BOX-AF Randomized Clinical Trial.
    Europace · 2026-11-13
    在持续性房颤首次射频消融中，常规附加改良后壁消融未提高12个月无心律失常生存率（86.3% vs 86.9%，HR 1.046，P=0.894），但急性成功实现肺静脉隔离后壁消融者复发率显著更低。
  • Novel cholesterol-high-density lipoprotein-glucose index is associated with 1-year recurrence of atrial fibrillation after catheter ablation.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-13
    在813例首次接受射频消融的房颤患者中，新型CHG指数每升高1单位，1年复发风险增加4.23倍，且预测能力优于TyG指数。
  • Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease, With and Without Increased Alcohol Intake, and Incident Atrial Fibrillation in Older Korean Adults: A Competing-Risk Cohort Study.
    Geriatr Gerontol Int · 2026-11-13
    在≥60岁韩国人群中，FLI定义的MetALD与房颤发生风险增加27%相关，而单纯MASLD与房颤的关联不确定。
  • Atrial Flutter in Adolescence Due to Invasive Cardiac Lipoma: A Rare Presentation.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-13
    14岁男性因侵袭性心脏脂肪瘤导致房扑，消融三尖瓣峡部依赖环路成功，但肿瘤相关第二环路无法消融，药物和电复律恢复窦律后心功能改善。
  • Ablation With Dual-Energy Lattice-Tip Catheter for Refractory Ventricular Tachycardia Adjacent to VSD Closure Device.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-13
    一例64岁室间隔缺损封堵器植入后难治性室速患者，使用Sphere-9双能量导管在封堵器附近成功完成射频消融和脉冲场消融，无并发症且术后室速不可诱发。
  • Comparative analysis of first-time pulmonary vein isolation in atrial fibrillation patients with heart failure with reduced versus non-reduced ejection fraction: A retrospective single-center study.
    Kardiol Pol · 2026-11-13
  • Task Force 8: Care of Competitive Athletes with Arrhythmias and Sudden Cardiac Arrest: Clinical Considerations and Electrocardiogram Interpretations.
    Med Sci Sports Exerc · 2026-11-13
    该文件为竞技运动员心律失常和心脏性猝死风险管理提供个体化评估、共同决策和重返赛场协议，强调区分低危与高危并给出心电图解读指导。
  • Clinically suspected acute myocarditis with ST-segment elevation, multiorgan dysfunction, and reversible conduction disturbance in an older patient receiving maintenance hemodialysis: A case report.
    Medicine (Baltimore) · 2026-11-13
    70岁维持性血透女性出现ST段抬高型心肌梗死样表现但冠脉无阻塞，临床疑诊急性心肌炎，病程中并发多器官功能障碍及可逆性窦性停搏，3个月时心脏未完全恢复。
  • Atrial fibrillation in chronic kidney disease - treatment standard.
    Nephrol Dial Transplant · 2026-11-13
    慢性肾病（CKD）G4-G5期房颤患者治疗证据有限，口服抗凝获益风险存争议，新型预防策略如XI因子抑制剂和左心耳封堵尚未证实安全有效。
  • Age-adjusted baseline D-dimer predicts thrombotic events during readmission in anticoagulated patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation
    Research Square · 2026-11-13
    在接受抗凝的非瓣膜性房颤患者中，年龄校正的基线D-二聚体升高独立预测再入院期间血栓事件，并提升CHA₂DS₂-VASc的预测价值。
  • Sleep apnea is associated with new-onset atrial fibrillation in patients undergoing peritoneal dialysis.
    BMC Nephrol · 2026-11-12
    在维持性腹膜透析患者中，新发房颤发生率为6.3/100患者年，睡眠呼吸暂停是其独立危险因素（HR 3.182），但新发房颤与卒中和死亡无关。
  • Effect of alpha-lipoic acid on atrial fibrillation and biomarkers of myocardial injury in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass surgery: study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial.
    Trials · 2026-11-12
    这项随机双盲安慰剂对照试验拟纳入50例CABG患者，评估围术期α-硫辛酸补充能否降低术后房颤发生率及心肌损伤标志物水平，目前仅为研究方案，尚无结果数据。

室性心律失常（7）

  • Painless Takotsubo Syndrome Triggered by Acute Exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD): A Retrospective Observational Study of Seven Cases.
    Cureus · 2026-11-13
    COPD急性加重可无胸痛地诱发Takotsubo综合征，7例中5例心室功能完全恢复，1例部分恢复，1例死于难治性室性心律失常。
  • Cardiac electro-structural remodelling and arrhythmia risks across the spectrum of obesity defined by the new Lancet framework.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-11-13
    基于英国生物银行48.8万人的分析显示，按Lancet新框架定义的临床肥胖与室上性、缓慢性及室性心律失常风险均显著升高相关，而临床前肥胖仅与室上性和缓慢性心律失常风险升高相关。
  • Case Report: Multimodal imaging diagnosis of arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy complicated with thrombosis.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-13
    37岁女性致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）合并右室心尖多发血栓，经超声心动图和心脏磁共振确诊，规范抗凝后血栓溶解。
  • Case Report: Upper septal fascicular ventricular tachycardia mimicking supraventricular tachycardia: diagnostic pitfalls and mapping-guided ablation.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-13
    25岁男性窄QRS心动过速被误判为室上速，腺苷揭示房室分离证实为室速，最终于上间隔部距希氏束8mm处消融成功且无传导损伤。
  • Cellular and molecular mechanisms of arrhythmogenesis in Takotsubo syndrome (Review).
    Int J Mol Med · 2026-11-13
    本综述系统梳理了Takotsubo综合征（TTS）心律失常发生的细胞与分子机制，涵盖钙处理异常、复极异常、结构重构导致的传导与不应期改变及自主神经失衡，并对应室性、房性与缓慢性心律失常的临床表现。
  • Task Force 9: Clinical Considerations for the Care of Athletes with Cardiac Channelopathies.
    Med Sci Sports Exerc · 2026-11-13
    对于患有心脏离子通道病的运动员，在专科评估、风险分层和适当治疗后，可通过共享决策模型支持其重返赛场。
  • Task Force 6: Clinical Considerations for the Care of Competitive Athletes with Congenital Heart Disease.
    Med Sci Sports Exerc · 2026-11-13
    本文提出基于解剖、生理、症状和心脏检查的评估策略，结合共享决策，指导先天性心脏病竞技运动员的运动参与决策，强调多数患者获益大于风险。

器械治疗（4）

  • Association Between Invasive Coronary Investigation Before Permanent Pacemaker Implantation and Mortality in a Historical Cohort with a One-Year Follow-Up: CorInPace Study.
    Braz J Cardiovasc Surg · 2026-11-13
    在紧急永久起搏器植入前进行冠状动脉造影未降低1年全因死亡率（HR 0.96），但住院时间更长且急性冠脉综合征发生率更高。
  • Left Bundle Branch Optimized Resynchronization Therapy for Persistent Ventricular Dysfunction After Complex PCI and TAVR.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-13
    一例67岁男性复杂PCI和TAVR后新发左束支传导阻滞伴左室功能不全，采用左束支优化心脏再同步治疗除颤器（LOT-CRTD）后3个月左室功能完全恢复。
  • Safety and Efficacy of Transvenous Lead Extraction Using a Right-Sided Approach.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-13
    右侧经静脉导线拔除术较左侧完全拔除率更低（94.53% vs 96.44%），胸骨切开术和上腔静脉/右心房撕裂风险更高，但30天死亡率无差异。
  • Cardiovascular events and interventions in patients with light chain amyloidosis: a real-world study in the United States.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-12
    美国AL淀粉样变性患者真实世界研究显示，平均随访2.1年期间64.6%发生心血管事件，16.7%接受心血管干预，且事件累积发生率随心脏分期加重而显著升高。

遗传与基础（2）

  • Molecular to Clinical Perspectives in Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy: Current Understanding and Future Therapeutic Directions.
    FASEB J · 2026-11-13
    致心律失常性心肌病由桥粒基因突变引起，通过Wnt、PPARγ、Hippo-YAP等通路导致心肌丢失、纤维化和脂肪化，诊断依据国际任务组标准，治疗包括ICD和射频消融。
  • Hypokalaemia-Induced Arrhythmias: Mechanisms of hERG Channel Dysregulation and Current Therapeutic Strategies
    International Journal of Drug Discovery and Pharmacology · 2026-11-13
    低钾血症通过hERG通道慢性内化降解及CaMKII激活诱发心律失常，现有补钾治疗不充分，多机制策略或更优。

item.title: 2026-11-13 心脏电生理日报（46 篇）
item.description:
共 46 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（25）

  • An ideal suspect: atrial flutter unmasked by implantable cardioverter defibrillator interrogation.
    Acta Cardiol · 2026-11-12
  • Predictive value of systemic inflammatory indices for new-onset atrial fibrillation after acute myocardial infarction: an interpretable machine learning study.
    Ann Med · 2026-11-12
    在3077例急性心肌梗死患者中，基于血常规的炎症指数与院内新发房颤相关，但机器学习模型显示其增量预测价值有限，需外部验证。
  • New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Critically Ill Patients: A Systematic Review of In-Hospital and Post-Discharge Outcomes.
    Crit Care Med · 2026-11-12
    重症患者新发房颤（NOAF）发生率约10.6%，出院后系统性血栓栓塞风险较无NOAF者近2倍，但抗凝治疗率仅约三分之一。
  • The Impact of Energy Drinks on the Genesis of Cardiac Arrhythmias: A Narrative Review.
    Cureus · 2026-11-12
    健康人群单次饮用能量饮料可致QTc间期延长，但未记录到临床显著心律失常；病例报告提示能量饮料（尤其与酒精同服）可能与房颤发生相关。
  • Sex differences in atrial fibrillation incidence among individuals with metabolic syndrome: a narrative mini review.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-12
    代谢综合征使男女房颤风险均增加约1.4-1.9倍，但男性发病更早更高，女性绝经后风险陡增，机制涉及性激素驱动的脂肪分布与代谢差异。
  • Prompt versus deferred conditional cardioversion strategies after early AF recurrence following pulsed field ablation.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-12
    在PFA术后早期AF复发的患者中，48小时内尝试复律策略较延迟7天策略可显著降低后续AF负荷（平均减少12.6天），并降低持续复发风险。
  • Standardized 4-step surgical approach to address atrial fibrillation during coronary artery bypass grafting in a patient with severely reduced left ventricular function: a case report.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-12
    一例60岁男性严重左室功能减低合并阵发性房颤患者，在冠脉搭桥术中行标准化四步房颤手术，术后维持窦性心律8个月无复发。
  • Development and evaluation of a transesophageal echocardiography-derived left atrial appendage structure-function coupling index across the atrial fibrillation disease continuum.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-12
    经食管超声衍生的左心耳结构-功能耦合指数LAA-VI/LAA-GLS随房颤分期进展而升高，在未记录房颤患者中可识别出常规心房大小指标未捕捉的类房颤左心耳表型。
  • Benchmarking metabolic surrogate indices against body mass index for left atrial diameter in atrial fibrillation: a two-cohort study.
    Front Endocrinol (Lausanne) · 2026-11-12
    在房颤患者中，不含BMI的代谢替代指标对左房内径的额外解释力很小，而含BMI的复合指标大部分解释力与BMI共享，BMI本身提供了相似或更大的解释力。
  • Label-free comparative proteomic analysis reveals distinct profiles of direct oral anticoagulants in human endothelial cells.
    Front Pharmacol · 2026-11-12
    在无外部刺激条件下，四种DOAC暴露人脐静脉内皮细胞6小时，蛋白质组学显示共同及药物特异性蛋白丰度变化，提示DOACs可能存在抗凝外血管效应。
  • Response to Comment on: "Carbon footprint of direct oral anticoagulants in atrial fibrillation and venous thromboembolism".
    Haematologica · 2026-11-12
  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation: Navigating Heterogeneity in Clinical Evidence: JACC Evidence Review.
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
    本综述指出，LAAC 与抗凝治疗的 RCT 在人群表型、对照、器械代际和终点构建上差异显著，不宜简单合并；对抗凝可耐受的 AF 患者，抗凝仍是首选一线策略。
  • When and How to Consider Left Atrial Appendage Closure as a Management Option for Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: A European Perspective.
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure in Atrial Fibrillation Patients With High Risk of Stroke and Bleeding: An Individual Participant Data Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
    在卒中与出血双高危房颤患者中，左心耳封堵与现行药物治疗在主要疗效终点及大出血上均无显著差异，大出血风险随时间变化，1年时LAAC组累积发生率更高，3年时未显示出血获益。
  • Comparison of Outcomes Between Men and Women Treated With Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Oral Anticoagulation After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: An OPTION Subanalysis.
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
    房颤消融后，LAAC与OAC在男性和女性中的卒中/死亡复合终点无显著差异，但LAAC减少出血的幅度在男性中显著大于女性。
  • Antithrombotic Therapy Management After Left Atrial Appendage Closure: Current Regimens, Evolving Evidence, and the Control Group Dilemma.
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
    左心耳封堵术后抗栓策略中，DOAC单药较DAPT显著降低装置相关血栓风险，但现有证据质量低，需个体化治疗。
  • What Counts in a Stroke-Prevention Strategy?: A Patient-Centered Framework for Cardiovascular Care in Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
  • To Close or Not to Close, That Is the Question: A Neurological Perspective on Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion in High-Risk Atrial Fibrillation Patients.
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
  • Safer Stroke Prevention in Atrial Fibrillation: Factor XI/XIa Inhibitors, Left Atrial Appendage Closure, or Both?
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
  • LAAC for Atrial Fibrillation: Overhyped Device or Reasonable Alternative to Oral Anticoagulants?
    J Am Coll Cardiol · 2026-11-12
  • Catheter Ablation in Atrial Fibrillation With Prior Stroke or Transient Ischemic Attack: Insights From the CABANA Trial.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-11-12
  • Computed Tomography-Derived Left Atrial Intramyocardial Fat and Low-Voltage Zones in Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-12
    CT衍生的致密左房心肌内脂肪与房颤患者左房低电压区独立相关，或成为无创评估致心律失常基质的标志物。
  • Atrial Fibrillation Ablation in a Patient with Partial Anomalous Pulmonary Vein.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-11-12
    首例报道脉冲场消融用于部分性肺静脉异位引流合并房颤患者，成功隔离正常肺静脉，异常静脉及左房后右壁无需额外消融。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion and Percutaneous Coumadin Ridge Mass Exclusion: Two Targets, One Device.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    一例高出血风险房颤患者，选用Amplatzer Amulet封堵器同期完成左心耳封堵与菜花状移动性肿物隔绝，随访2年余证实肿物完全隔绝且稳定。
  • Imaging-Guided Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in an Adult Patient With Fontan Circulation.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    在Fontan循环成人患者中，多模态影像指导的室速基质消融成功消除右室流出道纤维化相关异常心室活动，12个月无复发。

室性心律失常（7）

  • Association of the systemic immune-inflammation index with in-hospital malignant ventricular arrhythmia in patients with acute myocardial infarction.
    Front Med (Lausanne) · 2026-11-12
    在13465例急性心肌梗死住院患者中，入院SII升高与院内恶性室性心律失常风险独立相关（每1-SD lnSII的OR 1.48），但加入临床模型后预测增益有限（ΔAUC 0.017）。
  • Risk Stratification and Outcomes of Right Atrial Phasic Function in Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy: A Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Study.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-11-12
    在致心律失常性右心室心肌病患者中，CMR测量的右心房储备应变降低是终末期心衰和恶性室性心律失常的独立预测因子，并提升传统风险模型的预测效能。
  • Transpulmonary Atrial Pacemaker Implantation in Fontan Circulation With Bilateral Glenn.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    在双侧Glenn吻合的Fontan循环患者中，经肺静脉途径行心内膜心房起搏可行且参数良好，但未能阻止心力衰竭进展。
  • Transvenous Coil Implant in a Patient With Lateral Tunnel Fontan: The Route Less Traveled.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    在侧隧道Fontan术后患者中，经半奇静脉植入线圈并结合乳房下发电机口袋，可安全实现经静脉ICD升级。
  • Long-Term Prognostic Value of Scar Characteristics in Cardiac Magnetic Resonance to Predict Appropriate Therapies in Primary Prevention.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-12
    在226例一级预防ICD植入患者中，LGE质量>10g和传导通道是长期恰当ICD治疗的独立预测因子，两者均无者恰当治疗率极低（阴性预测值92%）。
  • Association of Left Ventricular Epicardial Adipose Tissue and Lipomatous Metaplasia With Ventricular Tachycardia Circuitry and Recurrence Following Ablation in Patients With Non-Ischemic Cardiomyopathy.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-11-12
    在非缺血性心肌病患者中，左室心外膜脂肪厚度与VT关键位点相关，低密度与消融后VT复发独立相关，且与脂肪瘤样化生存在交互作用。
  • Relaxin-2 reverses diastolic dysfunction and suppresses sustained arrhythmias in a rat model of Heart Failure with preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF).
    PLoS One · 2026-11-12
    在ZSF1大鼠HFpEF模型中，重组人松弛素-2治疗2周可逆转舒张功能障碍并抑制持续性房性和室性心律失常，其机制可能与Wnt/β-catenin信号通路介导的传导速度改善有关。

器械治疗（8）

  • Rationale and Design of a Multicenter, Randomized Controlled Trial: LEAP-Block.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-11-12
    LEAP-Block 试验将验证左束支区域起搏相比右心室起搏能否降低房室传导阻滞且左室射血分数≥50%患者的心血管事件风险，计划纳入484例。
  • Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Postarrest Cardiac Procedures for Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-11-12
    在58,394例院外心脏骤停存活入院患者中，黑人和西班牙裔/拉丁裔患者接受左心导管、PCI、VAD和ICD的比例显著低于白人患者。
  • Perceived Social Support Among Patients with Permanent Cardiac Pacemakers.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-11-12
    横断面研究纳入120例永久起搏器患者，家庭与重要他人社会支持评分高（约27/28分），朋友支持较低（16.7分），且支持水平与年龄、婚姻状况、合并症、植入年限及设备接受度相关。
  • Leadless Pacing Dyssynchrony and Diastolic Mitral Regurgitation Rescued by Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    92岁完全性房室传导阻滞患者双腔无导线起搏器植入9个月后出现起搏诱导性心肌病，升级为左束支区域起搏后QRS变窄、左室功能与二尖瓣反流改善。
  • Junctional Rhythm and Atrial Ectopy Presenting as Chronic Abdominal Pain in Fontan Circulation.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    32岁Fontan循环患者因慢性腹痛就诊，Holter发现交界性心律伴频发房性早搏，植入AAIR起搏器后腹痛完全缓解、功能改善。
  • Transvenous Atrial Pacing Using Subclavian 3-Dimensional Electroanatomical Mapping in Lateral Tunnel Fontan With Sinus Arrest.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    一例39岁侧隧道Fontan术后窦性停搏患者，经锁骨下三维电解剖标测定位存活心房组织，成功植入经静脉主动固定起搏导线，恢复1:1房室传导。
  • Novel Transvenous Approach for Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Implantation in a Patient With Fontan Circulation: Trans-Left Pulmonary Artery-Left Atrium.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-12
    首例经左肺动脉-左心房途径为Fontan循环患者植入ICD右室导线，术后未报告并发症。
  • Assessing the inclusion of frailty scores in either the methodology or results of clinical intervention trials of heart failure: A scoping review.
    PLoS One · 2026-11-12
    范围综述纳入10项心衰干预试验，仅1项为原始RCT，多数为事后分析；药物干预在各衰弱分层中疗效似保留，但衰弱测量异质性大、证据以回顾性为主。

遗传与基础（5）

  • Arrhythmogenic Left Ventricular Cardiomyopathy Associated with MYH7 Mutation.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-11-12
    一例58岁男性携带MYH7 p.Arg723Cys致病性变异，表现为房颤、非缺血性心肌病和左室收缩功能减低，经心脏磁共振和基因检测确诊为致心律失常性左室心肌病，并因广泛纤维化植入ICD进行一级预防。
  • Exploring the Potential Mechanisms Linking Bisphenol A Exposure to Atrial Fibrillation: An Integrated Multi-Dimensional Analysis from Network Toxicology to In Vivo Validation.
    OMICS · 2026-11-12
    双酚A暴露可能通过干扰CST3、GSTA1和PGF功能促进房颤，大鼠实验证实其增加房颤可诱发性并加重心房纤维化和炎症。
  • Multiple action potentials and complex calcium dynamics following electroporation of S-HEK cells depend on gap junction coupling.
    Sci Rep · 2026-11-12
    在S-HEK可兴奋细胞模型中，单个电脉冲诱发的多动作电位主要源于缝隙连接介导的沿细胞单层的持续传导，复杂钙反应则来自传导中同步的细胞外钙内流。
  • Dsg2 arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy is accompanied by neocortical synaptic changes in adult mice.
    Mol Brain · 2026-11-11
    Dsg2-W2A突变致心律失常性心肌病伴慢性心衰的老年小鼠，前额叶皮层I层兴奋性突触出现突触前末梢面积和突触囊泡数量减少，而突触后结构及突触相关细胞器未见明显改变。
  • Expanding the cardiac phenotype of homozygous PPA2 variants: insights from a large Finnish family.
    Orphanet J Rare Dis · 2026-11-11
    芬兰大家系中9例PPA2 c.380G>T纯合子携带者，2例青少年在酒精暴露后发生心脏骤停或暴发性心肌炎，其余7例无症状至成年。

其他（1）

  • An adaptive multi-scale dilated convolutional neural network for arrhythmia detection.
    Comput Methods Biomech Biomed Engin · 2026-11-12
    提出自适应多尺度空洞卷积网络AMSDNet，在MIT-BIH、CPSC2018和CINC2017数据集上平均准确率分别达99.7%、91.8%和83.7%，优于现有模型。

item.title: 2026-11-12 心脏电生理日报（19 篇）
item.description:
共 19 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（12）

  • Ventricular Pulsed Field Ablation: State-of-the-art Review of Preclinical and Clinical Evidence.
    Arrhythm Electrophysiol Rev · 2026-11-11
    系统综述111篇文献显示，心室脉冲场消融治疗室性心律失常累积434例，急性和长期结果总体良好，但安全性约束仍在探索中。
  • Association of Mean Left Atrial Pressure With Clinical Characteristics and Outcomes in Patients Undergoing Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: Subanalysis of the Shinshu Catheter Ablation (Shinshu-AB) Registry.
    Circ Rep · 2026-11-11
    房颤消融术中平均左房压升高与早期房颤复发风险增加独立相关，但与晚期复发及复合不良事件无关。
  • Leadless Pacemaker Implantation in Fabry Disease With Permanent Atrial Fibrillation and Bradycardia: Diagnostic and Implantation Guidance by Preprocedural Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-11-11
    法布雷病心肌病合并永久性房颤与心动过缓患者，术前心脏磁共振显示室间隔下部区域未受累，结合固定前电学标测可指导无导线起搏器植入位点选择。
  • [German Society of Cardiology position paper-how to treat patients with electrical storm: executive summary].
    Herzschrittmacherther Elektrophysiol · 2026-11-11
    德国心脏学会（DGK）立场文件提出STA三联征（基质、触发因素、心律失常）和NHII-MED框架，系统指导电风暴的风险分层与综合管理。
  • Bridging of Finger-Prick Volumetric Absorptive Microsampling and Conventional Venous Sampling with Clinical Specimens for Direct Oral Anticoagulants Analysis by LC-MS/MS.
    J Mass Spectrom Adv Clin Lab · 2026-11-11
    指尖采血VAMS与静脉采血所测DOAC浓度无显著差异，经LC-MS/MS验证并建立血浆-全血转换因子，支持VAMS用于DOAC治疗药物监测。
  • Association between nursing assessment indicators and adverse outcomes in hospitalized patients with atrial fibrillation: A retrospective observational study.
    Medicine (Baltimore) · 2026-11-11
    在312例住院房颤患者中，入院24小时内护理评估的跌倒风险、功能状态和营养风险与院内不良结局独立相关，高Morse评分和NRS-2002评分增加风险，高Barthel指数和白蛋白水平降低风险。
  • Persistent atrial fibrillation in older adults: Comparison of seven models and development of a gradient boosting machine classifier in a single-center observational study.
    Medicine (Baltimore) · 2026-11-11
    在572例≥60岁成人中，梯度提升机（GBM）模型区分持续性房颤的测试集AUC为0.919，与CatBoost和XGBoost相当，SHAP提示ALT贡献最大。
  • Development and validation of an explainable artificial intelligence model to predict in-hospital adverse events for patients with acute myocardial infarction.
    PLOS Digit Health · 2026-11-11
    基于入院常规数据构建的可解释机器学习模型可中等程度预测急性心肌梗死患者院内房颤、室颤、心脏骤停或死亡的复合终点，XGBoost 开发队列 AUROC 0.798，房颤与院内死亡预测较好，室颤和心脏骤停预测较弱。
  • Retraction: Hydrogen decreases susceptibility to AngII-induced atrial fibrillation and atrial fibrosis via the NOX4/ROS/NLRP3 and TGF-β1/Smad2/3 signaling pathways.
    PLoS One · 2026-11-11
  • Retraction notice to "Comparative Effectiveness and Safety of Cryoablation Versus Radiofrequency Ablation Treatments for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation" [The American Journal of Cardiology 184 (2022) 22 - 30]
    The American Journal of Cardiology · 2026-11-11
  • Machine learning framework to enhance and automate cardiovascular outpatient triage for patients with atrial fibrillation.
    BMC Med Inform Decis Mak · 2026-11-10
    基于6755例房颤转诊患者构建的两阶段机器学习框架，可识别需电生理专科治疗的患者，使EP直接转诊比例从20%提升至46%。
  • Association of preserved ratio impaired spirometry and restrictive spirometric pattern with incident atrial fibrillation: a cohort study.
    NPJ Prim Care Respir Med · 2026-11-10
    在无气流受限的成人中，保留比值受损肺功能（PRISm）与限制性肺功能模式（RSP）均与房颤新发风险升高相关，FEV1与FVC同时下降者关联最明确。

室性心律失常（4）

  • Electrical Storm Triggered by Conus Branch Occlusion During Elective Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in Very Severe Aortic Stenosis: Rescue With Balloon Aortic Valvuloplasty Under Venoarterial Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation.
    Catheter Cardiovasc Interv · 2026-11-11
    一例极重度主动脉瓣狭窄患者择期PCI中圆锥支闭塞诱发反复室速/室颤，VA-ECMO与IABP支持下血流动力学仍不稳定，急诊球囊主动脉瓣成形术后心律失常完全消失。
  • Vasospastic Angina and Cardiac Arrest.
    Circ Rep · 2026-11-11
    冠状动脉痉挛性心绞痛是院外心脏骤停可治疗病因之一，约占不明原因病例2-10%，确诊后钙通道阻滞剂治疗为主，但部分患者仍需评估ICD植入。
  • Sudden Liberalization at F.A.A. and Concerns for Aviation Safety: Active Implantable-Defibrillators in the Cockpit? Really?
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-11
    FAA首次允许植入ICD的飞行员恢复 unrestricted 飞行执照，此举引发对驾驶舱内ICD放电影响航空安全的担忧。
  • Shockingly Unreliable: A Case Report of Failure of Synchronized Cardioversion Device to Capture, Resulting in Ventricular Fibrillation and Cardiac Arrest.
    J Educ Teach Emerg Med · 2026-11-11
    一例65岁肥胖女性因不稳定宽QRS波心动过速行同步电复律时，设备同步失败导致T波上放电，诱发心室颤动并心脏骤停，经26分钟复苏后存活出院。

器械治疗（3）

  • Light-chain amyloidosis causing left ventricular outflow tract obstruction managed with a dual-chamber pacemaker: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-11-11
    67岁λ型AL心脏淀粉样变性患者合并SAM相关左室流出道梗阻，药物难治性晕厥，双腔起搏器右室心尖起搏后压差下降、症状持续改善逾1年。
  • Upgrading right ventricular pacing to left bundle branch area pacing in pacemaker-induced cardiomyopathy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-10
    在起搏器诱导心肌病患者中，升级为左束支区域起搏成功率高，可显著改善LVEF和症状，且可能优于双心室起搏，但证据限于观察性研究。
  • The efficacy of add on cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) to symptomatic patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction on sacubitril/valsartan treatment as regards left ventricle reverse remodeling and functional improvement.
    Egypt Heart J · 2026-11-10
    在QRS 130-149ms、接受沙库巴曲缬沙坦治疗的HFrEF患者中，加用CRT可改善左室逆重构、心功能并减少住院。

item.title: 2026-11-11 心脏电生理日报（33 篇）
item.description:
共 33 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（19）

  • Superior Versus Inferior Approach to Atrioventricular Node Ablation After Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing.
    Ann Noninvasive Electrocardiol · 2026-11-10
    在LBBAP后行AVN消融的起搏-消融一站式手术中，经起搏器囊袋的上位入路较股静脉下位入路总手术时间更短，安全有效。
  • Association between left atrial stiffness index and atrial fibrillation recurrence following radiofrequency ablation
    BMC Medical Imaging · 2026-11-10
    在240例首次接受射频消融的房颤患者中，左房僵硬指数（LASI）及其与BMI的Z评分标准化乘积（z-LASI-BMI）均独立预测术后12个月房颤复发，且z-LASI-BMI可提升预测区分度。
  • Association Between Brain Natriuretic Peptide Level and Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    Clin Appl Thromb Hemost · 2026-11-10
    本荟萃分析纳入11项研究共4761例受试者，发现BNP水平升高与房颤患病显著相关（合并SMD=1.08，95%CI 0.67–1.49，P<0.0001）。
  • Hemorrhagic Cardiac Tamponade in an End-Stage Renal Disease Patient on Apixaban.
    Cureus · 2026-11-10
    一例56岁血液透析房颤患者服用标准剂量阿哌沙班后发生出血性心脏压塞，经心包开窗引流450mL血性液体后血流动力学改善。
  • New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: Incidence, Outcomes, and Treatment.
    Dtsch Arztebl Int · 2026-11-10
    CABG术后新发房颤发生率约30-31%，连续监测下1年累积达48%，但房颤负荷低（0.07%），长期口服抗凝证据不明确。
  • Proton pump inhibitors in antithrombotic therapy: gastroprotection, drug interactions, and clinical management.
    Eur J Clin Pharmacol · 2026-11-10
    质子泵抑制剂可显著降低抗栓治疗患者上消化道出血风险，但获益集中于合并其他消化道出血危险因素者，应按消化道风险与抗栓强度个体化使用，而非普遍预防。
  • Distinct Gut Microbial and Metabolic Biomarkers Related to Atrial Fibrillation in Low-Risk Patients.
    Europace · 2026-11-10
  • Safety, effectiveness and healthcare resource implications of an early discharge pathway for cryoballoon ablation: real-world evidence from China.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-11-10
    中国单中心真实世界数据显示，冷冻球囊消融后48小时内早期出院与常规住院相比12个月房颤复发率无差异（8.75% vs 10.00%），且医疗服务费用更低。
  • ECG Holter-based screening for sleep-disordered breathing in post-stroke patients: a large monocentric cohort study.
    Front Neurosci · 2026-11-10
    在卒中后窦性心律患者中，基于动态心电图的TIDI和EDR指标可有效筛查睡眠呼吸障碍，TIDI阴性预测值高适于排除，EDR特异性高适于确认，联合规则可提高诊断准确性。
  • Stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation: radiobiology, clinical evidence, and emerging applications.
    Front Oncol · 2026-11-10
    立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）对难治性室速有效，在阵发性房颤中仅见初步可行性，其机制涉及早期电生理重塑而非仅纤维化。
  • Preventive Linear Ablation Strategy for Intra-Atrial Reentrant Tachycardia Following Cardiac Surgery.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-11-10
    心脏术后房内折返性心动过速患者，在激动标测消融基础上加做电压标测指导的预防性线性消融，可显著提高无房性心律失常生存率（82.6% vs 64.0%，P=0.019），但手术时间和射频时间延长。
  • Impedance-Based Contact Visualization for PulseSelect Pulmonary Vein Isolation: A Single-Center Feasibility Study.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-11-10
    单中心回顾性研究显示，在PulseSelect脉冲场消融PVI中引入基于阻抗的EnSite接触指数（CI）指导可行，与更多消融应用、更短透视时间及更少残余高电压单极电图相关。
  • Contemporary Outcomes of Catheter Ablation of Long-Standing Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-10
    当代长程持续性房颤导管消融队列中，允许重复消融时1年无心律失常生存率为53.5%，植入设备监测显示心律失常负荷显著降低。
  • True Left-Ventricular Aneurysm After Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation: The Role of Imaging in a Rare Complication.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-11-10
    一例室速消融后罕见真性左室室壁瘤病例，经多模态影像学检查明确诊断并指导手术治疗。
  • Arrhythmia management in transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy.
    Neth Heart J · 2026-11-10
    ATTR-CM心律失常负担高且以无症状缓慢型心律失常和AF为主，管理需结构化监测、节律控制及个体化器械决策。
  • Prevalence of thyroid dysfunction in patients with acute atrial fibrillation attending coronary care unit at Al-Sadder Teaching Hospital.
    Wiad Lek · 2026-11-10
    在因急性房颤入住CCU的110例患者中，甲状腺功能障碍患病率为21.7%，其中甲状腺功能亢进占12.7%，提示急性房颤患者需筛查甲状腺功能。
  • Beyond HAS-BLED in very elderly patients with atrial fibrillation treated with direct oral anticoagulants: predictors of major bleeding in a real-world cohort.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-09
    在≥90岁房颤DOAC患者中，HAS-BLED评分对主要出血无预测价值（AUC 0.46），而年龄增长及利伐沙班、达比加群（相较阿哌沙班）与出血风险升高独立相关。
  • Association of coronary artery calcium with atrial arrhythmia recurrence after catheter ablation according to atrial fibrillation type.
    Heart Vessels · 2026-11-09
    房颤消融术后，冠状动脉钙化积分≥100与房性心律失常复发相关，且该关联在阵发性房颤中更强（调整HR 5.59），非阵发性房颤中不显著。
  • Cardiac arrest associated with standard-dose carvedilol in combination with amiodarone: a case report.
    J Med Case Rep · 2026-11-09
    一例61岁房颤患者在接受标准剂量卡维地洛联合胺碘酮后发生严重心动过缓及两次PEA心脏骤停，提示常规剂量下也可出现BRASH生理。

室性心律失常（4）

  • [Importance of ventricular extrasystole coupling intervals for risk stratification].
    Arch Cardiol Mex · 2026-11-10
    本文讨论室性早搏联律间期测量在恶性室性心律失常与心源性猝死风险分层中的价值，并涵盖多形性室速诊断、右室流出道室速分型及缺血性心脏病与心衰的猝死风险评估。
  • Transient Type 1 Brugada ECG Pattern in a Patient With Severe Coronary Artery Disease.
    Cureus · 2026-11-10
    一例49岁严重多支冠脉病变伴心绞痛患者入院心电图呈1型Brugada图形，血运重建后该图形完全消失，提示为缺血相关的Brugada表型而非Brugada综合征。
  • Early ambulatory re-evaluation and follow-up of patients admitted in the acute cardiac care unit - Practical aspects on ambulatory follow-up of acute care patients: acute coronary syndromes, heart failure, ventricular arrhythmias, atrial arrhythmias, conductance disorders, myocarditis, pericarditis, other acute cardiac settings A Clinical Consensus Statement of the Association for Acute CardioVascular Care of the ESC.
    Eur Heart J Acute Cardiovasc Care · 2026-11-10
    ESC急性心血管护理协会发布共识，针对急性心脏事件出院患者提出结构化早期门诊随访的实用建议，强调风险分层、多学科团队和混合随访模式。
  • Associations of ECG-derived markers with clinical and biological characteristics in systemic sclerosis: preliminary findings from the SCAR-SSc study.
    J Med Life · 2026-11-10
    在34例无显性心血管病的系统性硬化症患者中，fQRS与室性早搏负荷独立相关，MVP评分与皮肤硬化程度、CRP及NT-proBNP相关，提示心电图标志物或可反映亚临床心脏受累。

器械治疗（2）

  • Safety and Efficacy of Omecamtiv Mecarbil by QRS Duration and Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy in GALACTIC-HF.
    JACC Heart Fail · 2026-11-10
    在 GALACTIC-HF 中，QRS≥120 ms 且未接受 CRT 的 HFrEF 患者从 omecamtiv mecarbil 获益较少，而 CRT 患者无论 QRS 宽度如何均获益。
  • Peri-procedural immune blood cell count changes and pacemaker implantation after transcatheter aortic valve implantation: an exploratory study.
    Kardiochir Torakochirurgia Pol · 2026-11-10
    TAVI术后淋巴细胞计数升高是起搏器植入的独立危险因素（OR=5.2），而淋巴细胞下降幅度较小者更需起搏器植入。

遗传与基础（6）

  • [Myocardial fibrosis and ventricular tachycardia in myotonic dystrophy type 1].
    Arch Cardiol Mex · 2026-11-10
    一例45岁1型强直性肌营养不良女性患者，心脏磁共振显示左心室29%质量延迟钆增强，伴持续性室性心动过速，植入ICD后随访无室性心律失常及器械治疗。
  • Enhanced prediction and risk stratification of atrial fibrillation with polygenic risk score in Chinese patients with type 2 diabetes
    Genome Medicine · 2026-11-10
    在中国2型糖尿病患者中，包含97个变异的房颤多基因风险评分是房颤的独立危险因素，将其加入CHARGE-AF评分可显著改善预测与风险分层。
  • Transforming cardiac amyloidosis care: navigating the evolving diagnostic and therapeutic landscape.
    Neth Heart J · 2026-11-10
    心脏淀粉样变（尤其ATTR-CM）已从罕见病转变为可治疗疾病，早期识别和疾病修饰治疗可改善预后。
  • Molecular profiling uncovers KCa2.3 as key driver of pacemaker cells in glioblastoma.
    Neuro Oncol · 2026-11-10
    分子谱分析发现KCa2.3是胶质母细胞瘤起搏细胞的关键驱动因子，遗传或药理抑制KCa2.3可选择性破坏起搏功能并减少肿瘤负荷。
  • Long Term Outcomes of Pediatric Patients After Catheter Ablation for Possible Arrhythmia Induced Cardiomyopathy.
    Pediatr Cardiol · 2026-11-10
    儿童疑似心律失常性心肌病经导管消融后88%成功，95%长期心功能正常，但极少数遗传性心肌病可能表现为继发性心律失常。
  • Single-nucleus transcriptomic analysis identifies a putative Purkinje fiber-associated remodeling program after myocardial infarction.
    BMC Cardiovasc Disord · 2026-11-09
    单核转录组分析提示心梗后存在一种过渡型浦肯野纤维相关转录重塑程序，但细胞丰度变化经多重校正后无统计学意义。

其他（2）

  • Long-term outcomes of intermuscular versus subcutaneous S-ICD implantation: extended follow-up of a propensity-matched multicentre analysis.
    Europace · 2026-11-10
  • Design and Validation of a Custom-Made Electrocardiogram Machine for Low-Cost, High-Fidelity Cardiac Monitoring.
    Turk Kardiyol Dern Ars · 2026-11-10
    自制低成本便携心电设备在1名健康志愿者和3例心律失常患者中实现稳定实时记录，波形形态与心律失常识别同商用系统初步一致。

item.title: 2026-11-10 心脏电生理日报（17 篇）
item.description:
共 17 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（8）

  • Preprocedural transesophageal echocardiography before cardioversion in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy-associated atrial fibrillation and thromboembolic risk: A follow-up, granular study.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-11-09
  • Deep Sedation in Single-Shot Pulmonary Vein Isolation: A Head-to-Head Look at Two Pulsed Field Versus Cryoballoon Ablation Approaches.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-09
    在深度镇静下，五分支脉冲场消融导管虽手术时间最短，但体重和时间校正的丙泊酚需求最高；球囊篮式导管可行性好且镇静需求低于五分支导管，安全性媲美冷冻球囊。
  • Prognostic Significance of Exercise-Induced Suppression of Idiopathic Premature Ventricular Complexes After Catheter Ablation
    Korean Circulation Journal · 2026-11-09
  • Social Support and Quality of Life in Patients with Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: The Mediating Role of Illness Perception.
    Patient Prefer Adherence · 2026-11-09
    在150例持续性房颤患者中，社会支持与生活质量正相关，疾病感知部分中介该关联（间接效应0.091，95%CI 0.036-0.144），模型解释57.5%的生活质量变异。
  • Left atrial functional characteristics using speckle tracking echocardiography in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation
    Tạp chí Phẫu thuật và Tim mạch và Lồng ngực Việt Nam · 2026-11-09
    在非瓣膜性房颤患者中，斑点追踪超声心动图显示左房储备、管道和收缩功能均较对照组显著降低（P<0.001）。
  • Knowledge and adherence to oral anticoagulant therapy among patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation at Hanoi Heart Hospital in 2025
    Tạp chí Phẫu thuật và Tim mạch và Lồng ngực Việt Nam · 2026-11-09
    越南河内心脏医院100例非瓣膜性房颤门诊患者中，78%对抗凝治疗知识不足，仅25%达到高依从性，清晰的医疗咨询和用药提醒与更好的依从性相关。
  • Zero-fluoroscopy radiofrequency catheter ablation: results from Hanoi Heart Hospital
    Tạp chí Phẫu thuật và Tim mạch và Lồng ngực Việt Nam · 2026-11-09
    在河内心脏医院97例接受三维电解剖标测系统零透视射频消融的心律失常患者中，手术成功率达98.9%，并发症少，随访中仅2例复发。
  • An ICAM1⁺ inflammatory fibroblast state in atrial fibrillation and metabolic-stress-associated atrial remodeling.
    Biol Direct · 2026-11-08
    房颤患者左心房中存在一种ICAM1⁺炎症性成纤维细胞状态，占成纤维细胞的17.3%，与炎症和基质重塑相关，并在饮食诱导肥胖小鼠中验证了Icam1上调与房颤易感性的关联。

室性心律失常（2）

  • Carbon monoxide exposure and the risk of cardiac arrhythmia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Int J Environ Health Res · 2026-11-09
    系统评价与荟萃分析显示，一氧化碳暴露与一般人群心律失常风险升高相关（OR 1.07、HR 1.25），但在植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）患者中未见显著关联。
  • Associations of the Low Arousal Threshold With Arrhythmia Burden and Heart Rate Variability in Obstructive Sleep Apnea Using Polysomnography With 24-h Holter Electrocardiography.
    J Sleep Res · 2026-11-08
    在166例接受整夜视频多导睡眠监测和24小时动态心电图的OSA患者中，低觉醒阈值表型与较低的室上性心律失常负荷独立相关，但心率变异性差异有限。

器械治疗（4）

  • Eighteen Years of Complication-Free Survival Following Inadvertent Left Ventricular Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator (ICD) Lead Placement via Atrial Septal Defect: A Case Report.
    Cureus · 2026-11-09
    一例经房间隔缺损误入左心室的ICD导线患者，采用抗凝观察策略后18年无并发症生存。
  • Mitral annular calcification on routine Non-ECG Gated Chest CT Is associated with advanced atrioventricular block requiring permanent pacing: A case-control study.
    Int J Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-11-09
    常规非门控胸部CT上二尖瓣环钙化（MAC）负荷与因晚期房室传导阻滞植入永久起搏器相关，MAC评分>400独立相关（OR 24.6）。
  • Adverse Event Profiles of Leadless Pacemaker Systems Reported to the FDA MAUDE Database (2021-2026).
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-09
    基于FDA MAUDE数据库2021-2026年14064份报告，Micra不良事件以穿孔相关并发症为主，Aveir以固定螺旋损伤、脱位及器械栓塞（尤其心房器械）为主。
  • Predictors of Success in Fractured Electrode Extraction: The Impact of Fracture Location and Access Strategies.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-11-09
